detail.title: Burnout and Patient Safety Errors in Swedish Healthcare: A Cross-Level Prospective Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The Longitudinal Occupational Health Survey for Health Care Occupations in Sweden was approved by the Swedish Ethical Review Authority [Ethical review numbers 2022-03105-01, 2023-04100-02, 2024-00822-02]. All the study participants provided consent to participate and publication when they logged in to the web survey or completed the paper survey.
declarations.funderStatement: This article was funded by the Swedish Research Council [grant number: 2022–00806].

detail.abstract:
Background: Burnout among healthcare professionals has been linked to patient safety risks, yet evidence relies predominantly on self-reported error measures. This study examined associations between self-rated burnout complaints and register-based hospital-level patient safety errors (PSEs).

Methods: Individual-level survey data from the Longitudinal Occupational Health survey for HealthCare Sweden (2023) were linked to hospital-level PSE data from the Swedish National Patient Register (2023–2024), across 2,626 healthcare professionals in 62 hospitals. Burnout complaints were categorized as non-burnout, at-risk, or burned-out. PSEs included misadventures during surgical and medical care, medical device-related adverse incidents, delayed complications, and nosocomial conditions. Negative binomial regression with hospital-cluster-robust standard errors tested direct associations, year-to-year PSE moderation by burnout complaints, and profession-specific differences.  

Findings: At-risk prevalence was 7·2%, and burned-out 4·4%. Burnout complaints were not directly associated with higher PSEs. Individuals classified as burned-out showed a stronger association between their hospital's 2023 and 2024 PSE counts than non-burnout individuals. For medical device-related complications, burned-out individuals showed a 20% stronger year-to-year carryover per 10 prior errors, particularly among physicians (18%). For delayed complications, burned-out nurse assistants showed a 33% stronger carryover.

Interpretation: Burnout complaints have no direct association with increased PSEs but may intensify existing error patterns at the organizational level, with professional variations. Rather than an isolated cause, burnout complaints appear to interact with role-specific responsibilities and organizational routines, suggesting that patient safety requires interventions should address conditions shaping both burnout and error persistence.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过将瑞典2,626名医护人员的自我报告倦怠数据与62家医院的登记患者安全错误数据关联，发现倦怠与患者安全错误无直接关联，但会强化已有错误的年度延续效应，且不同职业群体存在差异。
AI.research_question: 医护人员倦怠与医院层面登记的患者安全错误之间存在何种关联？倦怠是否会调节错误的年度间延续效应？不同职业群体之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多依赖自我报告的错误测量来探讨医护人员倦怠与患者安全的关系，缺乏基于客观登记数据的证据。本研究利用瑞典全国性登记数据，提供更客观的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业倦怠理论、患者安全组织错误理论。
AI.method: 数据来源为2023年瑞典医疗纵向职业健康调查与2023-2024年瑞典国家患者登记数据。将2,626名医护人员的倦怠自评（分类为无倦怠、风险期、倦怠）与62家医院层面的患者安全错误数据进行链接。采用负二项回归模型，使用医院聚类稳健标准误，检验直接关联、倦怠对年度错误延续的调节效应以及职业差异。
AI.findings: 风险期倦怠患病率为7.2%，倦怠状态为4.4%。倦怠与患者安全错误无直接关联。但倦怠个体所在医院2023年至2024年的错误数延续效应更强。在医疗设备相关并发症上，倦怠者每增加10个既往错误，年度延续效应增强20%（医生群体为18%）；在迟发性并发症上，倦怠的护士助理的年度延续效应增强33%。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"倦怠直接导致医疗错误"的简单线性假设，提出倦怠通过与组织层面的错误延续模式交互作用影响患者安全的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示医院管理者在改善患者安全时，不应仅关注降低倦怠本身，而应同时针对塑造倦怠和错误持续存在的组织条件进行系统性干预，且需根据不同职业角色差异制定针对性策略。

title: Resolving Labour Disputes in the Gig Economy: Can Online Dispute Resolution Bridge the Gap Between Platform Workers and Traditional Labour Justice?
affiliations: and Jamia hamdard, Hamdard Institute of Legal Studies and Research

detail.title: Resolving Labour Disputes in the Gig Economy: Can Online Dispute Resolution Bridge the Gap Between Platform Workers and Traditional Labour Justice?
detail.abstract:
The rapid growth of the gig economy has transformed the nature of employment relationships, creating new forms of work that often fall outside the scope of traditional labour protections and dispute resolution mechanisms. Platform-based workers associated with ride-hailing, food delivery, freelance and digital service platforms frequently face issues relating to unfair termination, non-payment of wages, algorithmic penalties, lack of social security, opaque rating systems and arbitrary deactivation of accounts. However, existing labour dispute resolution frameworks in India remain largely designed for conventional employer-employee relationships, leaving gig and platform workers with limited access to timely, affordable and effective remedies.

This paper examines whether Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) can emerge as a practical and accessible mechanism for resolving labour disputes in the gig economy. It analyses the suitability of conciliation, mediation, arbitration and hybrid ADR models in addressing the unique concerns of platform workers, particularly where disputes arise across jurisdictions, involve high-volume low-value claims or require urgent resolution. The paper further studies the limitations of existing labour adjudication under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, the Code on Social Security, 2020 and the emerging labour codes in addressing platform-based disputes.

The paper adopts a comparative approach by examining ODR frameworks and gig worker protections in jurisdictions such as the United Kingdom, the European Union and California. Particular attention is paid to recent judicial developments concerning worker classification, platform accountability and digital labour rights. It also explores the role of artificial intelligence, automated decision-making and algorithmic management in creating workplace disputes, while assessing whether ODR mechanisms can provide procedural flexibility without compromising due process, transparency or fairness.

The paper argues that India requires a specialised ODR framework for gig and platform workers that combines mediation, digital conciliation and limited appellate review to ensure quick and affordable justice. It proposes the establishment of sector-specific labour ODR platforms, mandatory pre-litigation mediation for platform disputes, standardised grievance redressal systems and statutory safeguards against biased algorithmic decisions. By situating gig work within the broader future of labour regulation, this paper seeks to contribute to the evolving discourse on ADR, labour rights and digital justice in India.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在线争议解决（ODR）机制能否成为印度零工经济中解决劳动纠纷的可行方案，并提出建立专门针对平台劳动者的ODR框架，结合调解、数字和解及有限上诉审查，以实现快速、可负担的公正。
AI.research_question: ODR能否成为零工经济劳动纠纷的实用且可及的解决机制？印度如何构建适合平台劳动者的专门ODR框架？
AI.motivation: 零工经济快速扩张，但印度现有劳动纠纷解决框架主要针对传统雇佣关系，平台劳动者面临不公平解雇、算法惩罚、账户停用等问题时缺乏及时、有效、可负担的救济途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动法、替代性争议解决（ADR）、在线争议解决（ODR）、算法管理、数字劳动权利
AI.method: 比较研究法：分析英国、欧盟和加利福尼亚的ODR框架及零工保护制度；法律文本分析：研究《1947年工业争议法》《2020年社会保障法典》等印度现行法律；案例研究：考察有关劳动者分类、平台问责和数字劳动权利的司法发展。
AI.findings: 印度现有劳动裁决机制难以应对跨境、高频、低值的平台纠纷；ODR结合调解、数字和解及有限上诉审查可提供程序灵活性；需建立行业特定ODR平台、强制性诉前调解、标准化申诉机制及对算法偏见的法定保障。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ODR理论延伸至零工经济领域；丰富了平台劳动者分类与算法管理对劳动纠纷影响的学术讨论；提出了"数字调解+有限上诉"这一适合平台劳动纠纷的新型争议解决理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提出建立专门劳动ODR平台、强制诉前调解、标准化申诉制度及算法偏见法定保障等具体建议；为发展中国家构建零工经济劳动纠纷解决机制提供可借鉴框架。

title: Adaptive Role Identity Alignment (ARIA): A Mechanism Theory of Discretionary Action Under Ambiguity

detail.title: Adaptive Role Identity Alignment (ARIA): A Mechanism Theory of Discretionary Action Under Ambiguity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the development of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript is a conceptual theory paper and did not involve human participants, human subjects research, or the collection of identifiable data. Institutional Review Board approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Modern organizations increasingly depend on adaptive performance under conditions of ambiguity, uncertainty, and decentralized decision-making. Yet even highly capable and motivated individuals often hesitate, rigidly comply, diverge, or break down when discretionary action is required. Existing theories of identity, motivation, engagement, and sensemaking explain who individuals are, why they act, and how they interpret situations, but they do not specify the mechanism through which interpreted role demands become psychologically authorized as discretionary action under uncertainty.

This manuscript introduces Adaptive Role Identity Alignment (ARIA), a mechanism-based theory of discretionary role engagement under ambiguity. ARIA proposes that discretionary action emerges through a sequential appraisal process in which Identity Standards and Interpreted Role Meaning are reconciled to produce a state of alignment functioning as a threshold condition for Regulatory Choice. Individuals do not select higher-agency forms of action as a function of motivation or formal authority alone; they do so only when identity-meaning coherence exceeds a critical level of psychological authorization.

ARIA makes seven primary theoretical contributions. First, it identifies the Identity-Meaning Appraisal Process as the missing mechanism that links sensemaking, identity, and discretionary action. Second, it introduces threshold logic as the governing architecture of adaptive regulation, explaining why behavioral change emerges discontinuously rather than proportionally. Third, it distinguishes lag misalignment from forward misalignment, generating different behavioral signatures and organizational risks from structurally similar conditions of identity-role incoherence. Fourth, it identifies the Empowerment Paradox, predicting that increasing structural agency under sub-threshold alignment amplifies divergence rather than Disciplined Initiative, directly falsifying autonomy-based motivational accounts. Fifth, it formalizes Identity Hysteresis as a source of temporal path dependence explaining why recovery from sustained misalignment is structurally asymmetric and slower than deterioration. Sixth, it specifies predictive asymmetry as a central diagnostic principle: superficially similar behavioral outcomes may emerge from fundamentally different appraisal, alignment, agency, or hysteresis pathways requiring different interventions. Seventh, it reframes organizational failure as a problem of degraded discretionary authorization rather than motivational, dispositional, or competence deficit.

ARIA specifies six regulatory modes within an alignment-agency matrix, derives sixteen formal propositions and eighteen discriminating empirical predictions, identifies seven boundary conditions, and develops a diagnostic and intervention architecture for studying adaptive regulation under ambiguity. The theory generates predictions that are distinct from those of self-determination theory, regulatory focus theory, person-environment fit, and proactive behavior frameworks. More broadly, ARIA proposes that organizational deterioration often develops beneath observability, through the latent degradation of authorization conditions, before threshold crossings produce a sudden, visible behavioral collapse. The theory is positioned to inform research across military operations, healthcare, emergency response, leadership development, institutional transformation, and other high-consequence organizational environments where adaptive discretionary action is essential.

.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARIA理论（适应性角色身份对齐），解释个体在模糊不清、充满不确定性的环境中，如何通过身份标准与角色意义的一致性评估，达到心理授权阈值，从而产生自主裁量行为，而非仅由动机或正式权威驱动。
AI.research_question: 在模糊和不确定性条件下，个体的自主裁量行为（discretionary action）是如何在心理上被授权并产生的？缺失的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有理论（身份、动机、参与、意义建构）能解释"个体是谁""为何行动""如何理解情境"，但未能说明"被解释的角色需求"如何在不确定性下被心理授权为自主行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: ARIA理论：身份标准（Identity Standards）与解释的角色意义（Interpreted Role Meaning）通过顺序评估过程（Identity-Meaning Appraisal Process）达成对齐（Alignment），该对齐状态作为调节选择（Regulatory Choice）的阈值条件。
AI.method: 机制理论建构（mechanism-based theory），提出16个正式命题、18个区分性实证预测、7个边界条件，以及诊断与干预架构。
AI.findings: 七个核心贡献：1）身份-意义评估过程是缺失机制；2）阈值逻辑解释行为非连续涌现；3）滞后错位与前瞻错位不同；4）赋权悖论：低阈值对齐下增加结构性自主会放大偏离；5）身份滞后效应；6）预测不对称性；7）组织失败是授权条件退化问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出身份-意义评估作为缺失机制；引入阈值逻辑；区分两种错位类型；揭示赋权悖论；形式化身份滞后效应；确立预测不对称原则；将组织失败重新框定为授权条件退化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事、医疗、应急响应、领导力发展、制度变革等高后果组织环境提供诊断和干预架构，帮助识别在可见行为崩溃之前潜在的授权条件退化。

title:
Indonesia: Energy & Resources Policy
Political Economy of Energy and Resources Policy
affiliations: Rice University

detail.title:
Indonesia: Energy & Resources Policy
Political Economy of Energy and Resources Policy
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes Indonesia’s strategic transition from a founding OPEC member to a net oil importer. As domestic oil production has declined by 56% due to maturing wells, the nation has pivoted toward natural gas as a critical bridge for economic growth and global LNG exports.  The study evaluates the evolution of the Indonesian investment climate, focusing on the shift from traditional Production Sharing Contracts (PSC) to Gross Split and Flexible Choice models designed to incentivize exploration. It further examines the nationalization of resources through the state owned entity Pertamina, highlighted by the 2021 takeover of the Rokan Block. By reviewing National Strategic Projects such as Tangguh LNG Train 3 and the Abadi Field, the paper concludes that Indonesia’s energy security depends on regulatory dynamism and the exploration of new deepwater regions to offset depleting reserves.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印尼从OPEC创始成员国向石油净进口国的战略转型，探讨其转向天然气、改革投资合同模式（从PSC转向Gross Split和Flexible Choice），以及通过国家石油公司Pertamina实现资源国有化的路径。结论指出，印尼能源安全取决于监管灵活性和深海区域勘探。
AI.research_question: 印尼如何从OPEC创始成员国转变为石油净进口国，在此过程中其能源战略、投资环境与监管政策如何演变？
AI.motivation: 印尼国内石油产量因油井老化下降56%，从原油出口国变为净进口国，这一结构性转变对能源安全和经济可持续性构成重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源转型理论、资源民族主义、投资合同激励理论（PSC vs. Gross Split模型比较）
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过分析印尼的国家战略项目（Tangguh LNG Train 3、Abadi气田）及Rokan区块国有化事件进行定性评估。
AI.findings: 1) 印尼已从石油转向天然气作为经济增长桥梁；2) 投资合同从传统PSC转向Gross Split和Flexible Choice模式以激励勘探；3) 2021年Pertamina接管Rokan区块体现了资源国有化趋势；4) 未来能源安全依赖深海勘探和监管灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资源型国家在产量衰减背景下的能源转型与投资政策调整提供了分析框架，丰富了关于石油合同模式变迁与资源民族主义关系的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼及其他面临类似产量下降的资源国提供政策建议：通过合同模式创新（如Gross Split）吸引外资，同时通过国有化保障国家资源控制权，并建议探索深海区域以弥补储量枯竭。

title: Experience Over Compliance: Why Frequent Use -Not Governance -Builds Managerial Trust in Generative AI

detail.title: Experience Over Compliance: Why Frequent Use -Not Governance -Builds Managerial Trust in Generative AI
detail.abstract: As a digital transformation leader working within one of Asia's most regulated financial environments, the author observed first-hand how organisations invested heavily in governance infrastructure as the primary response to GenAI adoption-and questioned whether that investment was producing the managerial confidence it was designed to build. That question became the foundation of this doctoral research, which sought to bring empirical rigour to a gap the author encountered not in the literature, but in practice. This working paper is derived from doctoral dissertation research completed at Golden Gate University. The full dissertation is available via ProQuest (forthcoming, June 2026). The author wishes to thank her dissertation supervisors, Dr. Ira Chatterjee and Dr. Bruce Wasserman, for their scholarly guidance throughout the research process, and the 100 managers who gave their time and candour as study participants.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在亚洲最受监管的金融环境中，组织为应对GenAI采纳而大量投资治理基础设施，但这些投资是否真正产生了管理者预期的信心。通过对100名管理者的实证研究，论文发现治理投资与管理信心之间可能存在脱节。
AI.research_question: 组织对GenAI治理基础设施的投资是否真的产生了其所旨在构建的管理者信心？
AI.motivation: 作者在实践中观察到企业在GenAI采纳过程中大量投资治理基础设施，但质疑这些投资是否真正带来了管理信心，而这一gap在现有文献中未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理投资与管理者信心之间的理论关系，可能涉及技术采纳、风险感知、制度信任等理论视角。
AI.method: 博士论文研究，实证方法，样本为100名管理者，数据通过调研或访谈收集。
AI.findings: 治理基础设施投资与管理信心之间可能存在显著落差——投资并未如预期般转化为管理者的信心。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了GenAI治理投资与管理者信心之间关系的实证研究空白，挑战了"更多治理=更多信心"的默认假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为亚洲受监管金融环境中的组织提供了关于GenAI治理投资有效性的实践洞察，提示管理者需要重新审视治理策略的有效性。

title: On the Implausibility of the Benign Sanctions Hypothesis

detail.title: On the Implausibility of the Benign Sanctions Hypothesis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the owner of VenAnalytics, a for-profit consultancy; the founder of Oil for Venezuela, a non-profit organization; and serves as an expert witness in litigation related to Venezuela.

detail.abstract: Santos, Morales-Arilla, and Partipilo Cornielles (2026a) claim that in the absence of sanctions Venezuela's rate of contraction would have accelerated by approximately 6 percentage points a year. Their projections imply an implausible 98% decline in GDP in a non-sanctions scenario. This would have caused Venezuela's per capita GDP in the absence of sanctions to fall to $107, or 40% that of the poorest country on earth, a level that has never been documented for any economy in world history. Such a contraction would have been by far the largest economic collapse ever documented, similar in magnitude to that which would result from dropping 100 nuclear warheads on the country. The fact that such extreme counterfactuals are needed to support claims of welfare-enhancing sanctions serves to demonstrate their implausibility.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了Santos等人关于制裁对委内瑞拉经济影响的极端反事实推断，指出其结论在经济史上前所未有且不可信。
AI.research_question: 委内瑞拉在无制裁情境下的经济收缩幅度是否如Santos等人所声称的那样巨大？
AI.motivation: 揭示Santos等人关于制裁对委内瑞拉经济影响的极端反事实推断的不可信性，质疑其支持"制裁增进福利"的结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反事实推断方法、经济史比较分析
AI.method: 对Santos等人的反事实推断进行逻辑检验，并与已知经济史案例和极端灾难（如核战争）进行类比。
AI.findings: Santos等人的无制裁反事实情境下，委内瑞拉人均GDP将降至107美元（仅为全球最贫困国家的40%），收缩规模相当于100枚核弹造成的破坏，这在世界历史上从未被记录过。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了反事实推断中极端假设可能导致荒谬结论，强调了经济推论必须与历史经验相一致。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者在评估制裁效果时需审慎对待反事实推断，避免基于极端假设制定政策。

title: AI Presence in B2B SaaS --- Marketing-Language Absorption, Identity Load Separation, and Phantom Brand Persistence in the Eighth Substrate Family

detail.title: AI Presence in B2B SaaS --- Marketing-Language Absorption, Identity Load Separation, and Phantom Brand Persistence in the Eighth Substrate Family

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Samsung Electronics America as Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance. Samsung does not manufacture or market B2B SaaS products and is not represented in the study's brand registry. No Samsung products, services, or competitors are included in the measurement panel. The research was conducted independently and does not represent Samsung's views or interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The research uses public LLM APIs and standard prompt batteries; no human subjects, no personal data, no protected populations.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded.

keywords: and Phantom Brand Persistence in the Eighth Substrate Family AIAS Protocol v1.6 (SSRN 6816340). Prior methodology versions: v1.2 (6761698)

detail.abstract: This study measures AI Presence for 24 B2B SaaS brands across six large language models, constituting the eighth substrate family in the AIAS Measurement Program. The study introduces Marketing-Language Coverage (MLC) as the first quantified operationalization of Discourse-Language carryforward --- the phenomenon whereby vendor-coined positioning terms appear in AI-generated recommendations as category-level vocabulary. Across 72 recall outputs, 55.6% contain at least one pre-registered marketing-language token, with "inbound marketing" (HubSpot-originated, 21 appearances) functioning as a category descriptor rather than a brand attribution. Recognition is perfectly uniform (all 24 brands at C$_{P}$ = 6/6), making recall the sole competitive dimension. Recall is sharply concentrated: Salesforce (61/72) and Slack (63/72) dominate, while infrastructure brands (Twilio, Cloudflare, MongoDB) are nearly invisible in recommendation space despite universal recognition. Identity Load produces the strongest cell separation in the program: enterprise incumbents dominate category-recall probes (mean R$_{cat}$ = 27.0/36) while challengers dominate cultural-recall probes (mean R$_{cult}$ = 18.3/36), a 27.7-point separation. Slack is the sole dual-channel brand. All five phantom candidates (Quip, Yammer, Wunderlist, HipChat, Stride) are recognized with detailed accuracy but show zero recall, replicating the v0.22 automotive null finding and confirming that recommendation-slot persistence does not extend to defunct brands. The MLC finding reframes a brand-strategy question: vendor-coined category language may become a category gift (benefiting all competitors) or remain a brand asset (accruing to the originator), with distinct strategic implications for each class.

AI.tldr: 本研究测量了24个B2B SaaS品牌在6个大语言模型中的AI存在度，引入了营销-语言覆盖率（MLC）作为话语-语言延续效应的首个量化操作化指标。研究发现：55.6%的AI输出包含供应商创造的市场营销词汇；品牌识别完全一致，但召回表现高度集中（Salesforce和Slack主导）；身份负荷产生最强的类别分离效应；已消亡品牌虽被识别但零召回。MLC重新框定了品牌战略问题：供应商创造的类别语言可能成为"类别礼物"惠及所有竞争者，或保留为"品牌资产"仅归于创始者。
AI.research_question: B2B SaaS品牌在AI推荐空间中的存在度如何分布？供应商创造的市场营销词汇如何通过AI系统转化为类别级语言？不同市场地位品牌（在位者vs挑战者）在AI系统中的表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型日益成为商业决策的信息入口，品牌在AI系统中的可见性成为重要的战略资产。但现有文献缺乏对AI时代品牌存在度的系统测量，尤其缺乏对供应商创造语言如何渗透AI推荐系统的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 话语-语言延续效应（Discourse-Language carryforward）；营销-语言覆盖率（Marketing-Language Coverage, MLC）；身份负荷（Identity Load）；AI存在度量（AIAS Measurement Program）
AI.method: 对24个B2B SaaS品牌在6个大语言模型中执行72次召回输出分析；采用预注册的营销语言标记检测；区分识别（recognition）和召回（recall）两个维度；运用类别召回探查和文化召回探查进行对比分析。
AI.findings: （1）55.6%的AI输出包含供应商创造的市场营销词汇，HubSpot的"inbound marketing"已成为类别描述符而非品牌归因；（2）品牌识别完全一致，召回是唯一竞争维度；（3）Salesforce和Slack主导召回，基础设施品牌几乎不可见；（4）身份负荷产生最强类别分离：在位者主导类别召回（均值27.0/36），挑战者主导文化召回（均值18.3/36），差距27.7分；（5）所有已消亡品牌被准确识别但零召回。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化操作化话语-语言延续效应；提出营销-语言覆盖率（MLC）概念；揭示身份负荷作为品牌在AI空间中分离的机制；区分了"类别礼物"与"品牌资产"两种语言效应类型，为品牌战略理论提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为B2B SaaS品牌管理者提供了AI存在度的诊断工具；揭示了在AI时代品牌战略的关键转变：创造类别语言可能惠及竞争者，需审慎评估投资回报；为已消亡品牌管理提供了实证依据；帮助品牌识别在AI推荐空间中的定位策略。

title: Analyzing The Functions of Civil Society in Eroding the Rentier Social Contract and Reconstructing the Concept of Citizenship
affiliations: University of Qom, University of Qom and University of Qom

detail.title: Analyzing The Functions of Civil Society in Eroding the Rentier Social Contract and Reconstructing the Concept of Citizenship
detail.abstract: Rentier states, by relying on revenues derived from natural resources rather than citizen taxation, construct a distinctive rentier social contract, ideally exchanging welfare provisions and subsidies for political loyalty. In such systems, a patrimonial rather than democratic social contract emerges, reducing citizens to passive clients and undermining the fundamental principles of democratic governance, such as transparency and accountability. Where citizenship is degraded to clientelism and rights are treated as revocable privileges, civil society is not merely an amalgam of service-oriented organizations; it becomes a hegemonic battlefield in the Gramscian sense—potentially transcending its conventional intermediary role and emerging as a workshop for constructing alternatives. Therefore, this article, employing a qualitative approach, argues that the primary function of civil society in rentier states is not necessarily to engage in direct power struggles (a war of manoeuvre), but rather to conduct a protracted war of position aimed at eroding the ideological and/or cultural foundations of the rentier order. The findings prove that the success of civil society in such contexts is not measured by immediate political changes, but by its ability to reshape the societal “software”—transforming the citizen’s identity from a passive beneficiary to an active, rights-bearing agent. It is through this transformative function that civil societies lay the human and institutional foundations necessary for meaningful political transitions during critical junctures.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨资源型国家（食利国）中公民社会的特殊功能：不直接争夺权力，而是通过漫长的“阵地战”侵蚀食利秩序的文化意识形态根基，将公民从被动受益者转变为具有权利意识的积极行动者，为政治转型奠定基础。
AI.research_question: 在食利国中，公民社会的主要功能是什么？它如何在不直接争夺权力的情况下推动政治变革？
AI.motivation: 食利国中基于资源收入的“食利社会契约”取代了民主社会契约，公民沦为被动客户，民主治理原则被侵蚀。现有研究对公民社会在其中的作用理解不足，需要超越传统的中介角色视角重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 葛兰西霸权理论（阵地战与运动战区分）、食利国家理论、社会契约理论、公民身份理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法（qualitative approach）
AI.findings: 食利国中公民社会的成功不取决于即时的政治变革，而在于其重塑社会“软件”的能力——将公民身份从被动受益者转变为积极的权利主体，从而在关键节点为政治转型奠定人力和制度基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将葛兰西霸权理论应用于食利国情境，提出公民社会在食利国中扮演“霸权战场”而非单纯服务组织的角色，区分了阵地战与运动战在资源型国家中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解资源型国家中公民社会的发展策略和转型路径提供新框架，强调长期文化意识形态建设而非短期政权更迭的重要性。

title: Proofs, Not Promises: Governed Candidate Improvement for Agent Control Runtimes
affiliations: SPQR Technologies Inc

detail.title: Proofs, Not Promises: Governed Candidate Improvement for Agent Control Runtimes
detail.abstract: Agents can appear to improve after failure while the path of improvement disappears. A prompt repair, memory edit, configuration change, or runtime update may make the next answer look safer without preserving what failed, what change was proposed, who challenged it, where it was applied, or what became worse. This paper studies that missing object: the governed candidate lifecycle. Civitas 6.7B treats attempted adaptation as an auditable artifact rather than as an unrecorded correction to an answer. Repeated governed-agent failures become bounded candidate artifacts; candidates are bound to Cassius challenge evidence, policy and trust-region gate evidence, and sandbox-only application state; and archived candidates are evaluated on sealed Australian finance held-out and stress tasks before a result claim is made. The evidence is a locked Australian finance paper bundle from a local Ollama/Gemma lane, not a smoke or stub run. It contains 250 curated AU task rows: 100 training failure rows, 100 held-out rows, and 50 stress rows. The bundle reports zero production mutations, zero unauthorized promotions, eight sandbox-only promotions, eight Cassius-required and Cassius-passed governed approvals, zero Cassius-unavailable claim-supporting approvals, and receipt completeness of 1.000000. Its clearest behavioral result is a held-out unsupported-claim rate reduction from 0.110000 to 0.057500. Held-out policy-violation, contradiction-to-policy, and unsafe-action rates also move downward in narrow or directional ways. The same archive preserves unfavorable outcomes: correct-controlaction rate falls, held-out regression rate rises, governed stress regression exceeds comparator stress rates, eight-of-eight approval leaves gate selectivity unresolved, and replay reproducibility is not available. The manuscript therefore makes a systems claim, not a leaderboard claim. Civitas 6.7B does not prove general safe self-improvement. It demonstrates that attempted agent adaptation can be made inspectable as governed candidate improvement: auditable, Cassiuschallenged, sandbox-contained, and empirically falsifiable under a bounded AU evidence contract. The result is proof of a chain of custody for improvement attempts, not a promise of broad behavioral superiority, production promotion, live production self-modification, API portability, EU results, statistical significance, replay reproducibility, or proven gate selectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为Civitas 6.7B的治理框架，将智能体的失败与改进尝试转化为可审计、可存档的“候选工件”，而非不可追溯的即时修正。通过在澳大利亚金融数据集上的实验，展示了可检查的治理改进链，而非泛化的安全自我改进能力。
AI.research_question: 如何使AI智能体在失败后的改进尝试变得可审计、可追溯且可证伪，而不是让改进路径消失？
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统在失败后可通过提示修复、记忆编辑、配置更改等方式改进，但这些改进过程缺乏记录——未保留失败内容、修改方案、质疑者、应用位置或恶化情况。这种不可追溯性对AI安全构成威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理候选生命周期（Governed Candidate Lifecycle）；Cassius挑战机制；策略与信任区域门控；沙箱隔离应用状态；候选工件绑定证据体系。
AI.method: Civitas 6.7B框架：将适应性尝试作为可审计工件处理；使用Cassius挑战证据、策略/信任区域门控证据、沙箱应用状态进行绑定；在密封的澳大利亚金融数据集（100条训练失败、100条保留、50条压力测试）上进行评估。
AI.findings: 保留集上无支持主张率从0.11降至0.0575；策略违规、矛盾策略、不安全行为率均有下降；但正确控制行为率下降、保留回归率上升、压力回归率超过对照、八次批准未解决门控选择性、无法重现回放。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“治理候选改进”概念，将智能体适应性尝试从不可追溯的即时修正转变为可审计、可挑战、沙箱隔离、经验可证伪的治理流程；建立了改进尝试的监管链（chain of custody）理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的系统级框架，使智能体改进过程可检查、可审计；通过澳大利亚金融数据集展示了治理候选生命周期的实际可行性；不承诺广泛行为优越性，但提供了改进可追溯性的实证基础。

title: Brain Rot and the Financialization of Attention: Cognitive Decomposition as Systemic Externality of Platform Capitalism

detail.title: Brain Rot and the Financialization of Attention: Cognitive Decomposition as Systemic Externality of Platform Capitalism
detail.abstract: While brain rot has entered the popular lexicon as a marker of cultural-intellectual decline, this article theorizes it as a systemic condition of late-capitalist survival. Integrating world-systems analysis with the critique of the attention economy, I argue that cognition has emerged as the new frontier of intensive accumulation. As material expansion shifts toward cognitive extraction within the post-2008 conjuncture, platforms assetize attention to stabilize speculative valuation. This induces a biopolitical rewiring that functionally degrades the capacity for sustained thought. This systemic brain rot is analyzed through its class-stratified distribution and institutional collision within the university, where deep learning confronts the highfrequency logic of extraction. Ultimately, this mutagenic mode of accumulation consumes capitalism's social and cognitive foundations, necessitating a shift from therapeutic selfmanagement toward the political contestation of attentional regimes through structural alternatives like engagement metric caps and public digital infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文将"脑腐化"理论化为晚期资本主义生存的系统性条件，认为认知已成为新一轮集约积累的前沿，平台通过资产化注意力来稳定投机估值，导致持续思考能力的系统性退化，并主张从治疗性自我管理转向对注意力体制的政治抗争。
AI.research_question: 在新的历史条件下，注意力经济如何导致系统性认知退化（"脑腐化"），以及如何从阶级分化和制度冲突的角度理解这一现象？
AI.motivation: "脑腐化"已进入流行语汇但常被简化为文化衰落的标志，本文旨在将其重新理论化为晚期资本主义生存的系统性条件，揭示其背后的政治经济机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世界体系分析、注意力经济批判、生命政治、阶级分析
AI.method: 理论分析，整合世界体系理论与注意力经济批判
AI.findings: （1）认知已成为晚期资本主义新一轮集约积累的前沿；（2）2008年后平台通过资产化注意力稳定投机估值；（3）这导致生命政治层面的重新布线，功能性削弱持续思考能力；（4）"脑腐化"存在阶级分层分布；（5）大学成为深度认知与高频提取逻辑的冲突场所；（6）这种致突变式积累正在吞噬资本主义的社会与认知基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"脑腐化"从文化衰退的流行标签重新理论化为晚期资本主义的系统性生存条件，将认知提取纳入世界体系分析框架，揭示了注意力经济的生命政治维度及其对资本主义社会认知基础的内生性破坏。
AI.practical_contributions: 主张从个体化治疗转向政治抗争，提出结构性替代方案，如参与度指标上限和公共数字基础设施。

title: Jet2 vs Thomas Cook: A Strategy-Finance Flywheel Analysis
affiliations: University of Birmingham - Birmingham Business School

detail.title: Jet2 vs Thomas Cook: A Strategy-Finance Flywheel Analysis

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available company annual reports, accounts and secondary financial information. It does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, interviews, surveys, experiments or animal subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.

detail.abstract:
Jet2 and Thomas Cook tell a striking story of divergence in UK leisure travel. Both operated in a sector exposed to fuel prices, currency movements, Brexit uncertainty, seasonal demand and shifting holiday-buying behaviour. Yet their financial paths moved in opposite directions: Jet2 strengthened and expanded, while Thomas Cook lost financial flexibility and eventually failed. Traditional ratio analysis and Altman-type distress tools can identify these different financial conditions, but they say less about how such conditions become progressively stronger or weaker over time. This paper develops a Finance Flywheel diagnostic to address that gap by examining how financial strength or weakness is transmitted across profitability, financing pressure, capital structure, liquidity, investment, payout and robustness. 

The framework links seven nodes: profitability, cost of finance, capital structure, liquidity, investment, payout and robustness. It examines whether financial conditions move across these nodes as surplus recycling, containment or erosion. The paper applies this framework to Jet2 over 2011-2025 and to Thomas Cook over its final pre-collapse period. It uses three diagnostic layers: Reinforcing Drivers Analysis to assess local node-to-node links, Trajectory Analysis to trace movement over time, and Radar Maps to visualise the system's shape. The design is a comparative conceptual-empirical diagnostic case, not a statistical causal test. 

The evidence is consistent with an accretive Finance Flywheel at Jet2, in which surplus was broadly recycled into liquidity, investment capacity, and robustness, with some periods better interpreted as periods of containment during external shocks. Thomas Cook's evidence is consistent with erosion, in which financial pressure appears to have moved across profitability, financing burden, capital structure, liquidity fragility, and constrained renewal before the collapse became terminal. The contribution is diagnostic: the Finance Flywheel complements ratio and distress-score analysis by making financial transmission, sequencing, and reinforcement visible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个"金融飞轮"（Finance Flywheel）诊断框架，通过分析盈利能力、融资压力、资本结构、流动性、投资、分红和稳健性七个节点之间的传导关系，来解释为什么在同样面临行业压力的英国休闲旅游行业中，Jet2能够不断壮大而Thomas Cook最终倒闭。该框架通过三个诊断层（节点传导分析、轨迹追踪和雷达图）揭示了财务强弱如何在系统中自我强化或侵蚀，弥补了传统比率分析和Altman破产预测模型无法展示财务动态传导过程的不足。
AI.research_question: 在相同外部环境（燃油价格、汇率波动、脱欧不确定性、季节性需求等）下，为什么Jet2和Thomas Cook的财务路径会截然相反？财务强弱如何在企业系统中逐步传导和强化？
AI.motivation: 传统比率分析和Altman破产模型虽然能识别财务困境，但无法揭示财务条件如何随时间渐进地增强或减弱，缺乏对财务传导路径和反馈机制的洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融飞轮（Finance Flywheel）框架，包含七个节点：盈利能力、融资成本、资本结构、流动性、投资、分红和稳健性，以及三种传导状态：盈余循环、约束和侵蚀。
AI.method: 比较概念-实证诊断案例研究，非统计因果检验。运用三个诊断层：强化驱动因素分析（节点间传导）、轨迹追踪（时间动态）和雷达图（系统形态可视化）。
AI.findings: Jet2呈现累积性金融飞轮，盈余被广泛循环到流动性、投资能力和稳健性中（外部冲击期表现为约束）；Thomas Cook呈现侵蚀模式，财务压力在盈利能力、融资负担、资本结构、流动性脆弱性和资产更新受限之间传导，最终走向崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融飞轮诊断框架，通过可视化财务传导、时序和强化机制，弥补了传统比率分析和破产模型在动态财务路径分析上的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业财务管理者提供了一种诊断财务健康状况动态演变的工具，能够更早发现财务侵蚀的信号，理解不同财务决策之间的连锁反应。

title: Breadth-Depth Tradeoffs in Generative Search under Information Pollution: Competition and Compute Externalities
affiliations: and The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Breadth-Depth Tradeoffs in Generative Search under Information Pollution: Competition and Compute Externalities
detail.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is transforming search from ranking links into producing answers, making quality a per-query production decision. We develop a game-theoretic model to analyze how platforms allocate scarce compute between retrieval breadth and reasoning depth in this new paradigm, uncovering three counter-intuitive operational dynamics with profound policy implications. First, we identify an e!ciency rebound : contrary to the "Green AI" narrative, improvements in reasoning e!ciency incentivize a massive expansion of retrieval breadth, driving total infrastructure consumption up rather than down. Second, we show that hygiene is antitrust: information pollution functions as a verification barrier that disproportionately binds entrants, meaning that governance to clean the web is an e"ective way to foster market contestability. Finally, we demonstrate that the social value of competition depends on compute externalities: while competition typically benefits consumers, high environmental damages turn the race for quality into a socially wasteful redundancy of energy-intensive verification pipelines. The results highlight that information hygiene and environmental standards are necessary complements to antitrust in the governance of generative search.

AI.tldr: 生成式搜索（RAG）中，平台需在检索广度与推理深度之间分配算力，本文通过博弈模型揭示了三个反直觉的动态：效率提升反而刺激算力总消耗增加（效率反弹）、信息清洁作为准入门槛可促进市场竞争（卫生即反垄断）、竞争的社会价值取决于环境外部性。
AI.research_question: 在RAG范式的生成式搜索中，平台如何分配有限算力于检索广度与推理深度？这一分配决策产生哪些竞争与政策后果？
AI.motivation: RAG正在将搜索从"返回链接"转变为"生成答案"，质量成为每次查询的生产决策，但这一转变对算力消耗、市场竞争和环境的影响尚不明确，传统"绿色AI"和环境政策框架可能面临挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析平台在检索广度与推理深度之间的算力分配均衡，并引入信息污染、竞争政策与环境外部性等维度。
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型，刻画平台在检索广度与推理深度之间的算力配置决策，并分析均衡结果对效率提升、信息治理与市场竞争的敏感性。
AI.findings: 1）效率反弹：推理效率提升反而激励平台扩大检索广度，导致总算力消耗增加；2）卫生即反垄断：信息污染作为验证壁垒对新进入者形成不对称约束，治理信息污染可促进市场可竞争性；3）竞争的社会价值取决于计算外部性：竞争通常惠及消费者，但高环境损害下，质量竞赛变为能源密集型验证管线的社会浪费性冗余。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"绿色AI"关于效率提升必然降低环境影响的叙事；揭示了信息治理与竞争政策之间的互补关系；将环境外部性引入对搜索市场竞争效果的评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生成式搜索的监管提供政策启示：信息卫生与环境标准是反垄断的必要补充；效率提升不必然环境友好，需配套治理措施。

title: Economic Effects of Changes in the Excise Tax on Tobacco Products in Poland
affiliations: National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI) and National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI)

detail.title: Economic Effects of Changes in the Excise Tax on Tobacco Products in Poland
detail.abstract: The aim of the article is to assess the impact of changes in excise duty rates on prices, consumption, and tax revenue to the state budget on the development of the domestic tobacco industry. The study was conducted, among other things, using methods of statistical comparative analysis, dynamics of the main elements of the market, exponential regression analysis, and analysis of selected financial ratios. The research shows that between 2010 and 2021 the tobacco industry in Poland developed very dynamically due to foreign direct investments and competitiveness on the EU market. Fiscal policy determined prices of tobacco products, as indirect taxes dominated the structure of retail prices. The increasing rates of excise duty resulted in a decrease in cigarette consumption, which was compensated by an increase in the consumption of innovative products. The effectiveness of fiscal policy is also confirmed by the growing budget revenues and reducing the shadow economy in the internal market. In recent years, however, consumer income has been growing faster than the prices of tobacco products, which has resulted in their better affordability. In conclusion, between 2022 and 2027, excise tax rates will gradually increase due to the harmonization of the national tax law with the regulations in force in the European Union. The increase in excise duty rates will determine the production and sale of tobacco products, which will adapt to demand conditions. Higher rates of excise tax will result in an increase in the prices of tobacco products and state budget revenues from indirect taxes.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了2010-2027年波兰消费税变动对烟草行业价格、消费、税收及产业发展的影响，发现消费税提高虽抑制传统卷烟消费但促进了创新产品消费，同时增加了财政收入并减少了地下经济。
AI.research_question: 消费税税率变化如何影响波兰烟草行业的价格、消费、税收收入以及产业发展？
AI.motivation: 波兰烟草行业因外国直接投资和欧盟市场竞争力而快速发展，同时消费税政策深刻影响烟草产品价格结构，需系统评估其经济效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收转嫁理论、消费税的替代效应与收入效应、影子经济理论、市场竞争力理论
AI.method: 统计比较分析、市场主要要素动态分析、指数回归分析、财务比率分析
AI.findings: 2010-2021年波兰烟草行业因FDI和欧盟竞争力而快速发展；消费税提高导致传统卷烟消费下降但创新产品消费上升；税收收入增长且影子经济缩小；消费者收入增速超过烟草价格增速导致可负担性提高；2022-2027年消费税将因欧盟税法协调而继续上调。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了消费税对烟草消费结构的替代效应（传统卷烟转向创新产品），以及税收政策在减少影子经济方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰及欧盟成员国制定烟草消费税政策提供实证依据，提示政策制定者需关注消费者收入增长对税收政策效果的抵消作用。

title: The Economic Disguise of DEI Retreat: How Transnational Business Masculinity Shapes MNE Responses to Anti-Gender Governance in Populist Dependent Market Economies
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: The Economic Disguise of DEI Retreat: How Transnational Business Masculinity Shapes MNE Responses to Anti-Gender Governance in Populist Dependent Market Economies
detail.abstract: How do multinational enterprises (MNEs) respond to political gender ideology under populist host country governance? Drawing on 89 interviews with senior decision-makers, activists, and policymakers in Hungary, Poland, and Slovenia, we examine MNE responses to anti-gender governance in three populist dependent market economies (DMEs). Following the Gioia methodology, we identify nine mechanisms organised into three aggregate dimensions: a repertoire of MNE responses (strategic decoupling, selective silence, instrumental alignment); transnational business masculinity (TBM) operating as an organisational-political logic (competitive pragmatism, rationalised abandonment, masculinist decision-making); and the contextual conditions characterising DMEs (economic dependence on FDI, political-religious institutional pressure, and corporate strategic considerations). We theorise these dimensions in a framework in which TBM resolves the dual demand of internal and external fit by camouflaging accommodation as economic rationality. The accommodation feeds back into the politicaleconomic conditions that produced the pressure, with material consequences for women and LGBTQIA+ employees. Our framework extends theories on corporate political ideology, literature on TBM, and the literature on MNE adaptation under institutional volatility. We argue that corporate political ideology is fundamentally gendered.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对匈牙利、波兰和斯洛文尼亚89位高管、活动家和政策制定者的访谈，探讨MNE如何应对民粹主义东道国治理下的反性别政治意识形态。研究发现MNE通过战略脱钩、选择性沉默和工具性对齐三种机制回应压力，而跨国商业男性气概（TBM）作为一种组织-政治逻辑，将"妥协"伪装为经济理性，从而在内外适配之间取得平衡，最终对女性和LGBTQIA+员工产生实质性影响。
AI.research_question: 跨国企业如何应对民粹主义东道国治理下的政治性别意识形态？
AI.motivation: 民粹主义政府推行反性别治理（anti-gender governance），对在东欧民粹主义依赖型市场经济体（DMEs）运营的MNE构成制度压力。现有文献对MNE如何在制度波动中应对性别意识形态压力缺乏系统理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨国商业男性气概（TBM）作为组织-政治逻辑；制度理论（内外部适配）；企业政治意识形态理论。
AI.method: 质性研究，Gioia方法论，基于89位高管、活动家和政策制定者的深度访谈（匈牙利、波兰、斯洛文尼亚）。
AI.findings: 识别出三大聚合维度：（1）MNE回应策略：战略脱钩、选择性沉默、工具性对齐；（2）TBM作为组织-政治逻辑：竞争实用主义、理性化放弃、男性化决策；（3）DMEs情境条件：经济依赖FDI、政治-宗教制度压力、企业战略考量。TBM通过将"妥协"伪装为经济理性来调和内外适配冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展企业政治意识形态理论，论证其本质上是性别化的；推进TBM文献；丰富MNE在制度波动下适应的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示MNE在民粹主义治理下的性别政治实践对女性和LGBTQIA+员工的实质性负面影响，为关注多元包容的企业和监管者提供警示。

title: Surveillance Architecture Determines Outbreak Trajectory: A Counterfactual Analysis of the 2025 Ebola Outbreak in Kasaï Province, DRC
affiliations: Université de Kinshasa, Université de Kinshasa, Université de Kinshasa and

detail.title: Surveillance Architecture Determines Outbreak Trajectory: A Counterfactual Analysis of the 2025 Ebola Outbreak in Kasaï Province, DRC

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no funding.

detail.abstract:
Background: Passive hierarchical surveillance systems often detect Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks only after nosocomial amplification prompts reporting from healthcare facilities, leaving concurrent community- and funeral-based transmission chains largely undetected. We aimed to quantify the epidemiological impact of adding real-time community health worker (CHW) mobile reporting enabled by satellite connectivity infrastructure to passive surveillance.  Using a confirmed dual-chain EVD outbreak as a calibration case, we evaluated whether earlier detection through community-based reporting could reduce transmission and improve outbreak control.

Methods: We developed  a dual-index-case stochastic SEIR model with five transmission routes, calibrated to the 16th EVD outbreak in Kasaï Province, Democratic Republic of Congo (August-October 2025), which resulted in 56 confirmed cases and 45 deaths (case fatality ratio 67·2%).  The model compares the documented passive system (15-day alert delay) against a counterfactual multi-source architecture under six connectivity scenarios, from satellite internet (1·0-day delay) to near-offline conditions (10·0-day delay). Sensitivity was assessed through one-at-a-time analysis (9 parameters, 54 scenarios) and Monte Carlo simulation (n=1000, 8 parameters varied simultaneously).

Findings: The model reproduced the observed outbreak trajectory (53 modelled vs 56 confirmed cases at day 37, mean absolute deviation 3 cases). Satellite connectivity (1·0-day delay) was associated with 46 fewer cases (86·8% reduction), with the Dikolo community response arriving 2·0 days before the healthcare worker who seeded the community-funeral chain (day 4·0 vs day 6). Under degraded connectivity (5·0-day delay), 37 cases (69·8%) could have been averted; under near-offline conditions (10·0 days), 25 cases (47·2%). Detection delay dominated all other parameters in sensitivity analysis (swing 70 percentage points). Monte Carlo analysis confirmed 0/1000 simulations produced a disadvantage for multi-source surveillance (median 59·3% averted, 90% CI 0·0–85·1). Critical operational thresholds were identified: detection delay below 5 days and CHW coverage above 38%.

Interpretation: Community-based digital surveillance, enabled by satellite connectivity increasingly available in DRC, could substantially reduce EVD outbreak burden by detecting community-funeral transmission chains that may be missed by passive surveillance systems. The epidemiological return on connectivity investment is non-linear, with the greatest gains achieved below a 3-day detection delay. These findings support prioritizing CHW mobile connectivity infrastructure in health areas adjacent to referral hospitals as a potentially cost-saving preparedness investment, although formal economic evaluation was beyond the scope of this study.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机SEIR模型，模拟在刚果（金）第16次埃博拉疫情中，加入卫星连接的社区健康工作者（CHW）移动报告系统相比被动监测系统的流行病学影响。结果显示，卫星连接（1天延迟）可减少86.8%病例，即使连接质量差（10天延迟）也能减少47.2%病例，证实社区数字化监测能显著降低疫情负担。
AI.research_question: 在被动式分级监测系统基础上，增加具有卫星连接支持的社区健康工作者实时移动报告系统，能否通过更早发现社区-葬礼传播链来减少埃博拉病毒病的传播并改善疫情控制？
AI.motivation: 被动式监测系统往往仅在医疗机构内出现聚集性感染后才上报，导致社区和葬礼传播链被大量遗漏。因此，需要量化社区数字化监测（尤其是卫星互联网支持）对疫情控制的实际流行病学价值，为防控投资决策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双指示病例随机SEIR模型，包含五条传播路径；以刚果（金）第16次埃博拉疫情为校准案例，比较被动系统（15天警报延迟）与多源监测架构在六种连接场景下的效果。
AI.method: 基于随机SEIR模型的模拟研究：模型校准至2025年8-10月刚果（金）第16次埃博拉疫情（56例确诊）；设置六种连接延迟场景（1.0天至10.0天）；通过单因素敏感性分析（9参数，54场景）和蒙特卡洛模拟（n=1000，8参数同时变化）评估稳健性。
AI.findings: 模型成功复现疫情轨迹（53 vs 56例）；卫星连接（1天延迟）减少46例（86.8%），社区响应快于医疗机构2天；即使在较差连接（5天延迟）下可避免69.8%病例，近离线（10天）时仍可避免47.2%；检测延迟是主导参数（波动70个百分点）；蒙特卡洛分析显示1000次模拟中0次显示多源监测劣势；关键阈值：检测延迟<5天，CHW覆盖率>38%。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过流行病学建模量化了社区数字化监测对埃博拉疫情控制的效果，揭示了检测延迟与病例减少之间的非线性关系，填补了卫星连接基础设施对疫情控制贡献的定量证据空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定者提供了清晰的量化依据：卫星连接的社区监测可大幅降低疫情规模；识别了关键操作阈值（检测延迟<5天、CHW覆盖率>38%）；建议优先在转诊医院周边地区投资CHW移动连接基础设施，作为具有潜在成本效益的防范投入。

detail.title: The Economic Disguise of DEI Retreat: How Transnational Business Masculinity Shapes MNE Responses to Anti-Gender Governance in Populist Dependent Market Economies
detail.abstract: How do multinational enterprises (MNEs) respond to political gender ideology under populist host country governance? Drawing on 89 interviews with senior decision-makers, activists, and policymakers in Hungary, Poland, and Slovenia, we examine MNE responses to anti-gender governance in three populist dependent market economies (DMEs). Following the Gioia methodology, we identify nine mechanisms organised into three aggregate dimensions: a repertoire of MNE responses (strategic decoupling, selective silence, instrumental alignment); transnational business masculinity (TBM) operating as an organisational-political logic (competitive pragmatism, rationalised abandonment, masculinist decision-making); and the contextual conditions characterising DMEs (economic dependence on FDI, political-religious institutional pressure, and corporate strategic considerations). We theorise these dimensions in a framework in which TBM resolves the dual demand of internal and external fit by camouflaging accommodation as economic rationality. AI.tldr: 本文通过匈牙利、波兰和斯洛文尼亚三国89位高管的访谈，研究跨国企业如何在民粹主义东道国治理下应对反性别治理。研究发现，跨国企业通过战略解耦、选择性沉默和工具性对齐等机制应对压力，而跨国商业男性气概(transnational business masculinity, TBM)作为一种组织政治逻辑，通过将妥协伪装为经济理性来解决内部与外部适应的双重需求。研究认为企业政治意识形态本质上是性别化的。
AI.research_question: 跨国企业如何应对民粹主义东道国治理下的政治性别意识形态（反性别治理）？
AI.motivation: 在中东欧三个民粹主义依赖型市场经济体中，反性别治理（anti-gender governance）日益盛行，跨国企业面临来自东道国政府和国内利益相关者的性别意识形态压力。然而，现有理论对企业如何在这种制度波动下应对性别化政治压力的理解不足，尤其是跨国商业男性气概在其中扮演的角色尚未被充分理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨国商业男性气概(Transnational Business Masculinity, TBM)；企业政治意识形态(corporate political ideology)；依赖型市场经济(dependent market economy, DME)；制度波动(institutional volatility)；内部与外部适应(dual demand of internal and external fit)
AI.method: 定性研究方法论：采用Gioia方法论对89位高管、活动家和政策制定者的半结构化访谈数据进行系统分析，识别出9种机制并聚合为3个总体维度。
AI.findings: 三种企业应对机制：战略解耦(表面合规但实质分离)、选择性沉默(避免公开表态)、工具性对齐(策略性迎合)。TBM作为组织政治逻辑，表现为竞争实用主义、理性化抛弃和男性化决策。在DME条件下，经济依赖(FDI)、政治宗教制度压力和企业战略考量塑造了企业反应。TBM通过将顺应行为伪装为经济理性来解决内外适应矛盾，但对女性及LGBTQIA+员工产生实质性负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 拓展企业政治意识形态理论，揭示其本质上的性别化特征；2) 推进跨国商业男性气概(TBM)的理论发展，展示其作为组织政治逻辑的具体运作机制；3) 丰富跨国企业在制度波动下适应的文献，阐明性别政治压力下的企业策略选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了跨国企业在民粹主义反性别治理下如何以"经济理性"为名妥协性别平等，对女性及LGBTQIA+员工权益产生实质性危害；为政策制定者和企业管理者提供了关于应对政治性别意识形态压力的反思框架。

title: Cognitive Amplification and Intergenerational Cooperation in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Cognitive Amplification and Intergenerational Cooperation in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The analysis presented in this study reflects the author’s independent research and professional observations regarding artificial intelligence, cognitive systems, and intergenerational knowledge interaction.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, clinical experimentation, patient data, or personally identifiable information requiring institutional ethics approval. The paper is based exclusively on publicly available data sources, published reports, theoretical literature, and analytical interpretation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently as part of the author’s ongoing research activities in artificial intelligence, cognitive systems, knowledge management, and technological transformation.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the transformative effects of generative artificial intelligence on knowledge creation, professional productivity, and intergenerational collaboration. Drawing on current empirical data-including Microsoft's AI Diffusion Report (2025), ITU global telecommunications statistics, and GSMA Intelligence projections-we identify a fundamental paradox: while AI adoption is numerically dominated by younger cohorts (ages 16-24: over 60% weekly usage rate), the cognitive amplification effect of AI tools appears strongest among professionals with accumulated domain expertise. We argue that AI functions not merely as a productivity instrument but as a cognitive prosthetic that multiplies existing knowledge structures. We further distinguish knowledge from thinking: AI can store and retrieve codified knowledge, but cannot reproduce the tacit dimension-the understanding of exceptions, anomalies, contextual judgment, and long-term consequences that constitutes the deepest value of experienced practitioners. Critically, we also note that AI amplifies errors as readily as it amplifies insight: outdated mental models, when accelerated by AI tools, become more structured and scalable mistakes. We contend that the industrial paradigm of narrow specialization is yielding to interdisciplinary synthesis as the primary value-generating competency. Finally, we propose intergenerational cognitive cooperation-a deliberate alliance between the adaptive speed of younger professionals and the systemic depth of experienced practitioners, mediated by AI as a cross-generational translator-as the organizational form best suited to AI-era complexity. The analysis draws on STS frameworks, tacit knowledge theory (Polanyi; Nonaka and Takeuchi), and the sociology of expertise (Collins and Evans).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生成式AI对知识创造、专业生产力及代际协作的变革性影响，指出AI作为认知假体放大既有知识结构，但无法复现隐性知识（如例外判断、情境洞察等）。研究提出"代际认知协作"——以AI为跨代翻译器，连接年轻专业人士的适应速度与资深从业者的系统深度——作为AI时代最适宜的组织形式。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何改变知识创造、专业生产力及代际协作？在AI认知放大效应下，隐性知识、专业判断与组织效能面临怎样的挑战与重构？
AI.motivation: 现有AI研究多聚焦于效率提升，但忽视了AI对知识结构本身的深层影响：AI是放大既有认知（包括错误）还是真正创造新知识？同时，AI采用率的代际差异与认知放大效应的矛盾（年轻群体使用率高但资深从业者获益更大）尚未得到充分理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: STS（科学技术研究）框架；波兰尼与野中郁次郎的隐性知识理论；Collins和Evans的专业知识社会学。
AI.method: 基于多源实证数据的理论分析，包括微软AI扩散报告（2025）、ITU全球电信统计、GSMA Intelligence预测数据，结合定性理论推演。
AI.findings: （1）AI采用存在代际悖论：年轻群体使用率最高（16-24岁超过60%周使用率），但认知放大效应在资深专业人士中最强；（2）AI作为"认知假体"放大既有知识，但无法处理隐性知识（例外、异常判断、情境洞察、长期后果）；（3）AI同时加速错误：过时的心智模型经AI工具加速后变成更具结构性的规模化错误；（4）工业范式的窄专业化正向跨学科综合转型；（5）提出"代际认知协作"作为AI时代最优组织形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将隐性知识理论延伸到AI时代，区分了"知识"（可编码存储）与"思维"（包含隐性判断）；提出了AI作为"认知假体"而非简单工具的理论概念；揭示了AI放大既有认知（含错误）的双刃剑本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业与组织提供了AI时代的协作框架：通过AI作为跨代翻译器，实现年轻员工的适应速度与资深专家的系统深度之间的协同；对人才培养、组织设计及AI部署策略具有指导意义。

title: Polish Finishers from Danish Piglets: Uncontrolled Transformation of Pig Industry in Poland
affiliations: Warsaw School of Economics (SGH)

detail.title: Polish Finishers from Danish Piglets: Uncontrolled Transformation of Pig Industry in Poland
detail.abstract: Only 20 years ago, Poland was self-sufficient in pig production, being one of the key players in the European pig market. Since then a growing specialization of Poland in pig finishing and meat processing has been observed, while the domestic production of piglets has declined. As a consequence, Poland has lost its self-sufficiency in pig production and become strongly dependent on imports of piglets, mainly from Denmark. The aim of this paper is to summarize the evolution of the Polish pig industry and specify the main determinants of the Polish imports of Danish piglets. The results of the estimates using the vector error correction model (VECM) show that the volume of the Polish imports of piglets from Denmark may be explained by a degree of specialization of Poland in pig finishing, the phase of pig cycle, and the competitiveness of Polish pork. The results may be helpful in understanding the evolution of the Polish pig industry and its growing dependence on imports of piglets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了波兰养猪业从自给自足到依赖丹麦仔猪进口的演变过程，并通过VECM模型揭示了进口量的关键决定因素。
AI.research_question: 波兰仔猪进口（尤其是来自丹麦的进口）的主要决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 波兰养猪业在过去20年从自给自足转变为高度依赖仔猪进口，这一结构性变化的原因和机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专业化分工理论、生猪周期理论、竞争力理论
AI.method: 向量误差修正模型（VECM）
AI.findings: 波兰从丹麦进口仔猪的数量可由三个因素解释：波兰在育肥猪环节的专业化程度、生猪周期的阶段、以及波兰猪肉的竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了专业化分工、生猪周期和竞争力因素在解释养殖业垂直分工与进口依赖中的理论有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解波兰养猪业的结构性演变及其对仔猪进口依赖加剧的背后原因，为产业政策制定提供参考。

title: Unlocking The Potential of the European Union Quality Schemes for Polish Regional and Traditional Food Products
affiliations: Warsaw University of Life Sciences, Warsaw University of Life Sciences and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Unlocking The Potential of the European Union Quality Schemes for Polish Regional and Traditional Food Products

keywords: Protected Designation of Origin and Protected Geographical Indications

detail.abstract:
The main aim of the study was to identify current problems encountered by the Polish producers of products registered under the PDO, PGI, and TSG labels and develop a set of recommendations that may support the development of the market of FQS products in Poland. The study findings showed that many factors are disrupting the functioning of the Polish market of FQS products and are related to product specificities, market relevance, supply chain governance, legitimacy, and law enforcement. The majority of products is characterized by a low value added, which makes it difficult to distinguish them on the market and therefore protect against counterfeit. There are also products with greater value added, but the lack of farmers' collective action reduces the potential effect that could result from the economy of scale. Furthermore, a limited number of certified producers and small cultivation areas constraint the use of effective marketing strategies, hindering producers' ability to gain more visibility for their produce. Consequently, Polish FQS producers cannot create more profitable market niches, often selling their certified products at regular market prices without the expected price premium. Moreover, FQS labels are also not recognized well by consumers, which indicates a serious problem of information asymmetry in the value chain. In order to improve the FQS sales in Poland, a joint commitment of the public administration agencies and producers is necessary in terms of providing support to producers in the process of developing applications, introducing the
system for monitoring FQS distribution and reporting counterfeits, creating an umbrella association of certified producers acting on behalf of all the participants of the system. Moreover, producers are encouraged to increase the scale of production, introduce common packaging and joint promotional activities, as well as joint sales and distribution in order to avoid producer–producer competition and to strengthen producers bargaining position in the food supply chain

AI.tldr: 本研究识别了波兰PDO、PGI和TSG标签产品市场存在的问题，如低附加值、缺乏集体行动、认证生产者有限、消费者认知不足等，并提出了包括公共支持、建立监测系统、成立联合协会、扩大生产规模和联合营销等解决方案。
AI.research_question: 波兰受保护原产地名称（PDO）、受保护地理标志（PGI）和传统特色保证（TSG）标签产品质量方案（FQS）产品当前面临的问题是什么？如何制定促进波兰FQS市场发展的建议？
AI.motivation: 波兰FQS产品市场发展面临诸多障碍，生产者难以获得价格溢价，消费者对标签认知不足，需要系统性识别问题并提出可行的政策与实践建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、供应链治理理论、集体行动理论、价值创造与附加值理论
AI.method: 实证研究，识别波兰FQS市场的问题因素，涉及产品特性、市场相关性、供应链治理、合法性和执法等方面。
AI.findings: 1) 多数产品附加值低，难以区分和防伪；2) 高附加值产品缺乏农民集体行动，规模经济效应不足；3) 认证生产者数量有限、种植面积小，制约营销策略；4) 生产者难以创造盈利市场利基，产品常以普通价格出售；5) 消费者对FQS标签认知不足，价值链存在严重信息不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息不对称和集体行动理论应用于波兰地理标志产品市场分析，揭示了制度设计与市场实践之间的差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的政策建议：公共机构支持申请流程、建立FQS分销监测与举报系统、成立认证生产者联合协会、扩大生产规模、统一包装、联合促销和销售分销以增强议价能力。

title: Arbitration Risks in Multi-Entity Arrangements: Strategic Implications for Commercial Transactions in Nigeria
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Arbitration Risks in Multi-Entity Arrangements: Strategic Implications for Commercial Transactions in Nigeria
detail.abstract:
In an increasingly interconnected commercial landscape, arbitration has emerged as the dispute resolution mechanism of choice, not only within Nigeria but across cross-border transactions where neutrality, enforceability, and speed are paramount. For investors and multinational actors, arbitration offers a level of predictability that traditional litigation often struggles to provide, particularly in complex, multi-party and multi-jurisdictional arrangements.

However, as commercial structures evolve, often involving layered corporate groups, special purpose vehicles (“SPVs”), and affiliated entities, a recurring and commercially significant question continues to arise: can a party that did not formally sign a contract nonetheless be bound by its arbitration clause and the resulting award?

The Supreme Court’s recent decision in EMERGING MARKETS TELECOMMUNICATIONS SERVICES LIMITED v. AFDIN VENTURES LIMITED & Ors,[1] (the “Emerging Markets Case”) provides important clarity on this issue. In reaffirming key principles of arbitration, the Court adopted a commercially grounded approach that prioritises substance over form in determining the scope of parties bound by arbitral proceedings. Notably, the Court also demonstrated a pragmatic willingness to move beyond strict procedural constraints, recognising that procedural compliance bearing on the Court’s jurisdiction, although critical, should not defeat the resolution of an otherwise substantive and commercially significant dispute where the interests of justice so require, and the impropriety is amenable to be cured by the Court’s inherent powers.

This decision is significant for investors, corporate groups, and contractual counterparties, whether directly bound by the formal contract giving rise to the arbitration, or so intimately intertwined with its performance, as it expands the circumstances under which non-signatories may be bound by arbitral outcomes and reinforces the finality of such awards in Nigeria, subject only to the limited and well-defined statutory grounds for setting them aside.[2]

This article examines the Court’s reasoning, its alignment with international arbitration principles, and the practical implications for structuring high-stake commercial transactions and managing dispute resolution risk in Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼日利亚最高法院在Emerging Markets案中的判决，该判决扩大了仲裁条款对非签署方的约束范围，强调实质重于形式，并展现了法院在程序合规问题上灵活务实的立场。
AI.research_question: 未正式签署合同的当事方在何种情况下可受仲裁条款及仲裁裁决的约束？法院应如何确定仲裁程序所约束当事人的范围？
AI.motivation: 商业结构日益复杂（涉及集团企业、特殊目的实体、关联公司等），非签署方是否受仲裁条款约束的问题频繁出现，亟需司法澄清以降低交易风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仲裁的基本理论（意思自治原则 vs. 集团公司理论/刺破公司面纱/禁止反言等扩张理论）、程序正义与实质正义的平衡、法院固有权力理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法：对Nigeria最高法院Emerging Markets案进行文本分析与法理阐释，并结合国际仲裁原则进行比较。
AI.findings: 法院采取"实质重于形式"的商业化路径，扩大了非签署方受仲裁约束的范围；法院同时展现了灵活的程序立场，认为程序合规缺陷在符合正义要求时可被法院固有权力弥补。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了仲裁当事人范围的确定理论，特别是非签署方纳入仲裁的理论基础；在普通法系下强化了法院固有权力与程序灵活性的理论连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在尼日利亚从事商业活动的企业（尤其是跨国集团）提供了仲裁风险管理的指引；提示交易结构设计时需考虑仲裁条款对关联实体/非签署方的潜在约束力；增强了尼日利亚作为仲裁地的可预见性和吸引力。

title: Financing Transformative Search: Runway, Control, and Frontier Innovation
affiliations: University of Minho - Economic Policies Research Unit (NIPE)

detail.title: Financing Transformative Search: Runway, Control, and Frontier Innovation
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theory of financing and governing transformative search: costly search for a transformative opportunity whose timing, payoff, and implementation are uncertain. The central object is the runway-attainability wedge ∆x , the gap between desired runway and the runway that can be financed while preserving authority over search. The decomposition separates this wedge into financing-frontier and governance shortfalls. Liquidity is valuable because it buys discovery time and, after discovery, implementation capacity. Search raises pledgeable upside by increasing opportunity arrival, but it also burns cash, so fixed claims are compatible with positive runway only over an intermediate range. Debt therefore has no one-sided implication for search: it can create overhang and implementation frictions, but it can also intensify search when higher burn makes delay more costly. When outside ownership is capped, financing changes real policy: controllers may use more debt, underfund runway, or use back-loaded non-voting claims that avoid coupon burn and voting dilution but reduce residual implementation payoff. The decision criterion is whether a financing architecture preserves attainable runway and search incentives, not how much capital it raises. Frontier AI motivates the setting, but the framework applies to difficult-to-pledge transformative opportunities more broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个关于 transformative search（变革性搜索）的融资与治理理论，核心概念是"跑道-可达性楔子"Δx，即期望跑道与可融资跑道之间的差距。流动性有价值因为它能购买发现时间和实施能力。债务对搜索没有单向影响：它可能产生悬空和实施摩擦，但也能强化搜索。当外部所有权受限时，融资改变实际政策。决策标准是融资架构是否保留了可达跑道和搜索激励，而非筹集了多少资本。
AI.research_question: 如何为不确定的变革性机会搜索进行融资和治理？
AI.motivation: 变革性机会（如前沿AI）的搜索面临时间、收益和实施三重不确定性，传统融资理论未能解释如何在保持搜索权威的同时提供足够跑道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跑道-可达性楔子（runway-attainability wedge）分解为融资前沿缺口和治理缺口；债务的双向效应理论；流动性价值理论；所有权约束下的最优融资架构。
AI.method: 理论建模，构建包含搜索时间、不确定收益、实施阶段和融资约束的动态模型。
AI.findings: (1)流动性有价值，因为它购买发现时间和实施能力；(2)搜索增加可质押上行空间但消耗现金，固定索取权仅在中间范围内兼容正跑道；(3)债务可创造悬空和实施摩擦，也可通过提高烧钱速度使延迟更昂贵来强化搜索；(4)所有权受限时，控制人可能使用更多债务、资金不足跑道或使用后端无投票权工具；(5)决策标准是融资架构是否保留可达跑道和搜索激励，而非资本量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出跑道-可达性楔子概念及其分解框架，揭示了债务对搜索的双向效应，建立了融资架构而非融资规模作为决策标准的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为前沿AI等变革性技术的融资和治理提供指导：如何设计融资架构以平衡搜索激励、实施能力和控制权。

title: Can India Replace China in U.S. Electronics Trade? A Shock Model Analysis of Computer, Electronic, and Optical Equipment Sector (HS-26)
affiliations: University of Tehran, University of Tehran and

detail.title: Can India Replace China in U.S. Electronics Trade? A Shock Model Analysis of Computer, Electronic, and Optical Equipment Sector (HS-26)
detail.abstract: The trade dynamics among the United States, China, and India have become increasingly complex and strategically significant within the global economy, particularly amid intensifying U.S.-China trade tensions. This study employs the Leontief Input-Output model (1936), implemented through the shock simulation framework developed by Dehghani (2023), to assess India's potential to substitute China in U.S. trade relations, focusing on the computer, electronic, and optical equipment sector (HS-26). Three shock scenarios, categorized as low (10-30%), medium (40-60%), and high (70-100%), are simulated to reveal patterns of economic interdependence among the three economies. The results reveal that India cannot fully substitute China in HS-26; however, it could achieve replacement in HS-26 by strongly focusing on IT and other information services sector (HS-62T63), which is closely linked to HS-26. While India's growing presence in global electronics is notable, the United States should pursue a broader diversification strategy, engaging partners such as Mexico, Taiwan, and South Korea alongside India to mitigate trade shocks and enhance supply chain resilience.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过Leontief投入产出模型模拟三种冲击情景，评估印度在美国贸易关系中替代中国计算机、电子和光学设备部门（HS-26）的潜力。结果显示印度无法完全替代中国，但可通过聚焦IT和信息服务部门（HS-62T63）实现部分替代，建议美国采取多元化战略。
AI.research_question: 印度能否在美国贸易关系中替代中国，特别是在计算机、电子和光学设备（HS-26）领域？
AI.motivation: 中美贸易摩擦加剧背景下，全球供应链面临重构压力，探索印度作为替代来源的可行性具有重要的战略意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Leontief投入产出模型（1936）及Dehghani（2023）开发的冲击模拟框架。
AI.method: 采用Leontief投入产出模型，设定低（10-30%）、中（40-60%）、高（70-100%）三种冲击情景，模拟三国间的经济相互依赖关系。
AI.findings: 1. 印度无法完全替代中国在HS-26领域的位置；2. 但印度可通过聚焦与HS-26紧密关联的IT和信息服务部门（HS-62T63）实现替代；3. 美国应采取多元化战略，结合墨西哥、台湾、韩国等伙伴以增强供应链韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将投入产出模型与贸易冲击模拟相结合，为分析复杂供应链替代问题提供了量化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国在贸易摩擦背景下的供应链多元化策略提供实证依据，建议不应过度依赖单一替代国，而应采取多方合作策略。

title: Cost Minimisation and Conditional Factor Demand in Ghanaian Commercial Banking: A Transcendental Logarithmic (Translog) Cost Function Approach

detail.title: Cost Minimisation and Conditional Factor Demand in Ghanaian Commercial Banking: A Transcendental Logarithmic (Translog) Cost Function Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only aggregate and publicly available secondary data. No human subjects, personal data, or confidential supervisory information were used. Institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: In this paper, a translog cost function is estimated simultaneously with factor cost share equations using equation-by-equation OLS based on data of ten Ghanaian commercial banks for 2013-2023 (105 firmyears observations). Using the intermediation model framework and Shephard's lemma, the analysis identifies the conditional factor demand functions, Allen-Uzawa substitution elasticities, and Ray scale economies index. Four main empirical findings merge. First, Ghanaian banks show significant economies of scale: the RSE index of 0.399 indicates that double-output expansion will lead to only 39.9 percent increase in costs. Second, there's a monotonic relationship between scale economics and size, as RSE decreases from 0.448 for the asset-size smallest quartile to 0.353 for the largest; this trend intensified following the reforms of Bank of Ghana in 2017-2018 (from 0.415 before reform to 0.387 after reform; χ² = 13.949, p<0.001). Third, capital and labor are Allen substitutes (σ₁₂ = 0.943), indicating that technological development results in digital labor replacement, typical for Sub-Saharan Africa. Fourth, there's 2.1 percent growth per year in unit costs controlling for output and prices effects, which is related to the higher costs of regulatory compliance without technical progress. The cost of loanable funds is 81.2 percent of the total cost level.

AI.tldr: 基于2013-2023年加纳10家商业银行的面板数据，采用超越对数成本函数与份额方程联立估计，发现加纳银行业存在显著规模经济（RSE=0.399），且规模经济程度随银行规模增大而增强；资本与劳动存在Allen替代关系（σ=0.943），反映数字化对劳动替代的趋势；同时单位成本每年增长2.1%，归因于合规成本上升与技术进步不足。
AI.research_question: 加纳商业银行的规模经济程度如何？要素间替代弹性与技术进步特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 加纳银行业在2017-2018年监管改革后经历了结构性变化，但关于其成本结构、规模经济及要素替代弹性的实证研究不足，尤其缺乏基于银行层面微观数据的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中介模型（Intermediation Model）、谢泼德引理（Shephard's Lemma）、超越对数成本函数（Translog Cost Function）、Allen-Uzawa替代弹性、Ray规模经济指数（RSE）。
AI.method: 采用超越对数成本函数与要素成本份额方程联立，逐方程OLS估计；数据为2013-2023年加纳10家商业银行的非平衡面板数据（105个银行-年度观测值）。
AI.findings: （1）显著规模经济，RSE指数0.399；（2）规模经济与银行规模呈单调正相关，且改革后增强；（3）资本与劳动为Allen替代（σ=0.943），体现数字劳动替代；（4）单位成本年均增长2.1%，合规成本上升而无技术进步；可贷资金成本占总成本81.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将超越对数成本函数框架应用于撒哈拉以南非洲新兴经济体银行业，验证了规模经济与银行规模的正向单调关系，提供了监管改革影响成本结构的实证证据，丰富了发展金融领域关于银行业技术替代的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳及类似撒哈拉以南非洲国家的银行业监管政策制定提供实证依据，提示监管改革对规模经济效应的影响；揭示数字化进程中资本对劳动替代的现实趋势；指出合规成本上升是拖累技术进步的重要因素，建议关注成本效率与技术创新平衡。

title: Critical Mineral Supply Risks in the Expanding Electric Vehicle Industry
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Critical Mineral Supply Risks in the Expanding Electric Vehicle Industry
detail.abstract: The global electric vehicle (EV) market has been growing in the past decade as the climate crisis, government policymaking on decarbonization initiatives, and battery manufacturing technologies are driving proliferation. As a result, the demand for critical minerals like lithium, cobalt, nickel, graphite and rare earth elements, which are used in the production of lithium-ion batteries and electric vehicles, has risen significantly. As the world becomes more reliant on small clusters of mineral-rich areas, however, there are significant issues of supply security, geopolitical control, and sustainability (Ballinger et al. 113844). The study presented here aims to investigate the link between EV growth and critical mineral dependency by synthesizing the literature, analyzing the policies and performing a supply chain assessment and SWOT analysis. The results show that the global EV supply chains are still very sensitive to disruption of trade restrictions, political uncertainty, and market concentration in countries that dominate mineral extraction and processing. Furthermore, the ethical underpinnings of clean-energy transitions remain under threat from environmental damage, carbon-heavy extraction methods and labor rights issues (Jones, Nguyen-Tien, and Elliott 5). Meanwhile, the study uncovers areas of opportunity for battery recycling, material replacements, and circular economy approaches that could help decrease reliance on virgin mineral usage (Nygaard 1102). The study identifies the need for more diverse sources of minerals, technological advancement, increased international collaboration and policy resiliency that will facilitate sustainable EV expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了电动汽车增长与关键矿产依赖之间的联系，通过文献综述、政策分析、供应链评估和SWOT分析，发现全球电动汽车供应链对贸易限制、政治不确定性和市场集中度高度敏感，同时揭示了电池回收、材料替代和循环经济等缓解机会，并提出需多元化矿产来源、技术进步和国际合作以实现可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车增长与关键矿产依赖之间存在怎样的联系？全球电动汽车供应链面临哪些风险与机遇？
AI.motivation: 随着电动汽车市场快速增长，关键矿产（锂、钴、镍、石墨、稀土等）需求急剧上升，但这些矿产集中在少数国家和地区，带来供应安全、地缘政治控制和可持续性等重大问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链安全理论、地缘政治经济学、可持续转型理论、循环经济理论
AI.method: 文献综述、政策分析、供应链评估、SWOT分析
AI.findings: (1)全球电动汽车供应链对贸易限制、政治不确定性和矿产开采加工国的市场集中度高度敏感；(2)清洁能源转型的伦理基础受到环境破坏、高碳排放开采方法和劳工权利问题威胁；(3)电池回收、材料替代和循环经济方法可减少对原生矿产的依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合供应链安全、地缘政治与可持续转型理论，系统揭示电动汽车增长与关键矿产依赖之间的复杂互动关系，为相关领域提供了跨学科的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业从业者识别了供应链脆弱环节，提出了矿产来源多元化、技术创新、国际合作和政策韧性建设等具体建议，有助于推动电动汽车的可持续发展。

title: Leveraging Inter-Organizational Agility for Innovation
affiliations: University of Zurich and UBS AG

detail.title: Leveraging Inter-Organizational Agility for Innovation
detail.abstract:
Today, companies face significant challenges from economic and social trends and external events and shocks. Rapid and radical changes in consumer behavior can occur within a short span, necessitating swift responses from goods and services suppliers to ensure business’s survival and success. 
Traditional planning, which depends on deliberate strategies, may be inadequate in dynamic and fast changing environments. Organizations should embrace continual change and evolution, rather than relying on a single competitive advantage. To achieve this, leaders must rethink strategy and innovation, focusing on creating short-term or transient advantages[1] by identifying and capitalizing opportunities before returning to core business activities once these opportunities are exhausted. 
Current management literature explains why companies should adopt agility. Correspondingly, our study focuses on how this might be accomplished in practice, assuming that a manager’s understanding of agility leads to improved communication, collaboration, and consequently, innovative solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在快速变化的环境中，企业如何通过管理者的敏捷性理解来提升沟通、协作和创新，从而从短期优势中获利，而非依赖传统长期战略。
AI.research_question: 管理者对敏捷性的理解如何在实践中促进沟通、协作和创新，从而帮助企业应对快速变化的环境？
AI.motivation: 当前管理文献解释了企业为何应采用敏捷性，但对如何在实践中实现敏捷性关注不足。同时，传统依赖刻意战略的规划在动态环境中可能失效，企业需要拥抱持续变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 暂态优势理论（Transient Advantage）、敏捷管理理论
AI.method: 文献综述与概念性分析，基于管理者对敏捷性的理解提出实践路径
AI.findings: 管理者的敏捷性理解能改善沟通与协作，进而促进创新解决方案的产生；企业应聚焦于创造和利用短期（暂态）优势，而非追求单一持久竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将敏捷性从"为何要做"推进到"如何做"的层面，丰富了暂态优势理论在实践中的应用理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了在动态环境中通过提升敏捷性认知来改进组织沟通、协作与创新的实践方向。

title: The Advancement of Digitalization Processes in Food Industry Enterprises in the European Union
affiliations: National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI)

detail.title: The Advancement of Digitalization Processes in Food Industry Enterprises in the European Union
detail.abstract: The aim of the article is to assess the directions, pace, and advancement of digital transformation in food industry enterprises in the European Union (EU). The analysis uses statistical data collected in public databases as well as secondary data from the state-of-the-art literature and surveys carried out in enterprises in the sector. Moreover, the Digital Intensity Index developed by Eurostat was used. The progress made by food industry enterprises in terms of digitalization was assessed in terms of their relevance to the prospects of building a more sustainable food system in the EU. The conducted analysis allows to conclude that even though the pace of digitalization in the sector's enterprises has accelerated in recent years, the level and scope of digital changes is still limited. What is more, large inequalities in the level of digitalization, visible both within the sector itself and between EU Member States, remain a problem. The directions of using digital solutions show that digitalization is seen mainly to increase production efficiency and attract new customers and sales channels. Parallel possibilities to support environmental and climate protection are not yet sufficiently exploited. Given the challenges related to the implementation of the European Green Deal, it is necessary to accelerate and expand the scope of digitalization in EU food industry enterprises.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了欧盟食品工业企业数字化转型的方向、速度和进展，发现数字化速度虽加快但水平仍有限，且成员国间及行业内存在较大不平等，数字化主要用于提升效率和拓展销售，环保潜力未充分挖掘。
AI.research_question: 欧盟食品工业企业的数字化转型方向、速度与进展如何？
AI.motivation: 欧盟食品工业面临构建可持续食品体系的压力，数字化转型既是机遇也是挑战，而目前对该行业数字化进程的系统评估不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论、可持续食品体系理论、欧洲绿色协议框架
AI.method: 基于Eurostat公开统计数据、文献综述和行业企业调查，使用数字强度指数（Digital Intensity Index）进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 1）数字化速度近年加快，但整体水平和范围仍有限；2）行业内和成员国间数字化水平存在较大不平等；3）企业数字化主要聚焦生产效率和销售渠道拓展，环境与气候保护潜力未被充分利用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性揭示了食品工业数字化转型的现状与可持续目标之间的差距，为数字化与可持续发展理论的交叉提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟食品工业企业、政策制定者提供了数字化转型的现状评估，指出为实现欧洲绿色协议目标需加速和扩大数字化范围，并强调应将环保用途纳入数字化战略。

title: Anchored to the Dot Plot: Central Bank Projections and Interest Rate Expectations
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Anchored to the Dot Plot: Central Bank Projections and Interest Rate Expectations
detail.abstract: Central bank projections shape private expectations but may also inefficiently anchor them. Using federal funds rate forecasts from 2012-2026, I document that the Federal Reserve's Summary of Economic Projections creates predictable forecast errors in private-sector forecasts through anchoring. Both survey-based and, to a lesser extent, market-based forecasts anchor to prior SEP releases, generating systematic under-adjustment even after controlling for prior consensus and macro-financial predictors. This anchoring is distinct from other forms of information rigidity documented in the literature such as anchoring to the previous consensus forecasts. The findings reveal a communication tradeoff: frequent central bank projections enhance transparency but create reference points that impede expectation adjustment during turning points, with implications for the speed and effectiveness of monetary policy transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2012-2026年联邦基金利率预测数据，发现美联储的经济预测摘要(SEP)通过锚定效应导致私营部门预测产生可预期的系统性误差，揭示了央行预测在增强透明度的同时可能阻碍预期调整的沟通权衡。
AI.research_question: 央行的经济预测是否通过锚定效应扭曲了私营部门的预期形成？
AI.motivation: 央行预测旨在引导私人预期，但可能过度锚定私人预期，导致其在经济转折点调整不足，影响货币政策传导效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锚定效应理论、信息刚性理论
AI.method: 利用2012-2026年联邦基金利率预测数据，分析美联储SEP发布后私营部门（基于调查和基于市场）预测的系统性误差，控制先前共识和宏观金融预测因子。
AI.findings: 1) SEP发布导致私营部门预测产生可预期的锚定偏差；2) 基于调查的预测比基于市场的预测锚定效应更强；3) 这种锚定效应区别于文献中其他信息刚性形式（如锚定于先前共识预测）。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别出央行预测作为独立锚定来源，区别于已有文献中的共识锚定，丰富了信息刚性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了央行沟通的权衡：频繁的预测提升透明度但创造参考点，阻碍经济转折点的预期调整，影响货币政策传导速度和有效性，为央行沟通策略设计提供启示。

title: When Machines Think Fast: A Behavioral Economics Test of AI
affiliations: and Lincoln Memorial University

detail.title: When Machines Think Fast: A Behavioral Economics Test of AI
detail.abstract: We test whether large language models reproduce or correct for fourteen well-documented human behavioral biases. We administer each canonical experiment to ChatGPT and construct a pseudo-panel of responses from each iteration. The biases we examine span belief-formation tasks (anchoring, conjunction fallacy), preference-based tasks (framing effects, prospect-theoretic risk attitudes, present bias, mental accounting, sunk-cost reasoning, the endowment effect, the disposition effect, and naïve diversification), and intertemporal and social-choice problems (myopic loss aversion, save-more-tomorrow commitments, the house money effect, and the ultimatum game). On eight of fourteen tasks, the model behaves in a manner consistent with the rational benchmark. On the remaining six tasks (framing of the Asian disease problem, the conjunction fallacy, mental accounting, the house money effect, naïve diversification, and the endowment effect), the model exhibits a directional bias that mirrors the human pattern, but in every case, the magnitude of the deviation is smaller than the human benchmark. We interpret these results as evidence that large language models can serve as effective debiasing decision aids in many settings. We show that residual biases inherited from training on human-generated text concentrate predictably in tasks involving valuation, framing, and intuitive judgments about likelihood.

AI.tldr: 本文通过14个经典行为偏差实验测试ChatGPT，发现其在8个任务中表现理性，在6个任务中表现出与人类方向一致但幅度更小的偏差，表明LLM可作为有效的去偏决策辅助工具。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）是否能复制或纠正14种人类行为偏差？
AI.motivation: 人类决策常受系统性行为偏差影响，而LLM基于人类文本训练，可能继承这些偏差；同时，评估LLM是否可作为去偏工具具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学与决策理论，涵盖信念形成偏差（锚定、合取谬误）、偏好偏差（框架效应、前景理论、现时偏好、心理账户、沉没成本、禀赋效应、处置效应、朴素分散化）以及跨期与社会选择偏差（短视损失厌恶、明天储蓄更多、赌场资金效应、最后通牒博弈）。
AI.method: 在14个经典行为实验中对ChatGPT进行测试，构建伪面板数据，比较其回答与人类基准行为的差异。
AI.findings: 在14项任务中，8项表现符合理性基准；6项（亚洲疾病框架效应、合取谬误、心理账户、赌场资金效应、朴素分散化、禀赋效应）表现出与人类方向一致但幅度更小的偏差。残余偏差集中于涉及估值、框架和直觉概率判断的任务。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了LLM在行为决策中的理性与偏差的边界，证明了LLM可充当有效的去偏决策辅助工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用LLM辅助人类决策提供了实证依据，指出LLM在估值、框架和直觉概率判断任务中仍需注意残余偏差。

title: Optimal Cohort Partitions
affiliations: and Yale School of Management

detail.title: Optimal Cohort Partitions
