AI.theoretical_framework: 空间定量一般均衡模型、公共品理论、选举制度理论、移民与投票行为理论
AI.method: 构建包含人口迁移、公共品和选举的空间一般均衡模型，基于台湾的迁移和公共支出数据校准模型，并进行反事实模拟。
AI.findings: （1）引入缺席投票使支出转向全国性公共品，区域福利更均等；（2）居住地登记制下，地方公共品供给和福利的区域差异更大；（3）人口流动性越高，两种制度差异越大；（4）当流动性足够高且对全国性公共品偏好较弱时，居住地登记制在福利上优于缺席投票。
AI.theory_contributions: 将选举制度纳入空间经济学框架，揭示了选民登记规则和投票方式通过影响政治代表性进而塑造公共品供给和区域福利分配的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于选举制度设计（如是否允许缺席投票、是否实行居住地登记）如何影响区域均衡发展的实证依据。

title: Strategic Camouflage and Zombie Cartels: Endogenous Detection in Dynamic Cournot Competition

detail.title: Strategic Camouflage and Zombie Cartels: Endogenous Detection in Dynamic Cournot Competition
detail.abstract:
Competition authorities increasingly rely on empirical screening tools based on observable market signals, such as price anomalies and statistical indicators, to detect collusion. This raises the question of how firms adapt their behaviour in response to such detection mechanisms. 
      We develop an infinitely repeated Cournot model with endogenous detection, in which a Competition Authority allocates enforcement effort based on observed price distortions. Anticipating this response, cartel members have incentives to avoid generating conspicuous signals that could trigger investigation. In equilibrium, firms expand output relative to the monopoly benchmark in order to compress observable price distortions, leading to interior collusion. We refer to this mechanism as strategic camouflage. 
     We then introduce retroactive private damages in the form of a liability stock that accumulates over time. As exposure builds up, the expected cost of detection increases, inducing firms to place greater weight on avoiding detection rather than maximizing short-run profits. The model predicts a gradual compression of observable price distortions even as collusion persists. We refer to this outcome as a zombie cartel. While such behaviour is difficult to observe directly, the mechanism highlights how stock-based liability may induce firms to operate with relatively small observable distortions while remaining coordinated. 
     Overall, enforcement based on observable price signals may transform cartel behaviour rather than eliminate it: collusion becomes less visible but potentially more persistent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究竞争当局基于可观测价格信号（如价格异常和统计指标）来检测合谋时，企业如何调整其行为。通过构建一个内生检测的无限重复古诺模型，发现企业会通过扩大产出压缩价格扭曲以规避调查（"战略伪装"），而引入追溯性私人损害赔偿（责任存量）后，企业会进一步缩小价格扭曲形成"僵尸卡特尔"——合谋虽持续但更隐蔽、更难被检测。
AI.research_question: 当竞争当局依赖可观测市场信号（如价格异常）来检测合谋时，企业会如何调整其行为？以及引入追溯性私人损害赔偿后，这种动态如何变化？
AI.motivation: 现实中竞争当局越来越多地使用基于价格信号的经验筛选工具来检测合谋，但企业可能针对这些检测机制做出策略性反应。理解这种互动对于设计有效的反垄断执法至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限重复古诺模型（内生检测机制）；战略伪装理论；责任存量（追溯性私人损害赔偿）动态模型；僵尸卡特尔概念。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个包含内生检测机制的无限重复古诺博弈模型，并在后续引入追溯性私人损害赔偿形成的责任存量，进行均衡分析。
AI.findings: （1）企业为规避基于价格信号的检测，会扩大产出以压缩可观测的价格扭曲，导致"内部合谋"（非垄断水平的合谋）；（2）引入追溯性私人损害赔偿后，随着责任存量的累积，企业更倾向于避免检测而非短期利润最大化，导致价格扭曲逐步压缩，形成"僵尸卡特尔"——合谋持续但信号微弱；（3）基于价格信号的执法可能使卡特尔行为从可见转向隐形，更具持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"战略伪装"和"僵尸卡特尔"两个新概念，揭示了执法工具（价格信号检测）与企业行为之间的内生互动，丰富了反垄断经济学中关于合谋检测与合谋行为演化的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争当局提供重要警示：依赖价格信号等可观测指标的筛查工具可能无法消除合谋，反而可能促使合谋以更隐蔽、更持久的形式存在；同时，追溯性私人损害赔偿制度的设计需要警惕其可能产生的"僵尸卡特尔"效应。

title: Determinants of Implementation of the Circular Economy in the Food Processing Sector on the Example of the Dairy Industry
affiliations: Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute, National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI) and Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics – National Research Institute

detail.title: Determinants of Implementation of the Circular Economy in the Food Processing Sector on the Example of the Dairy Industry
detail.abstract: The aim of the study is to present the determinants of the potential application of the circular economy model in the food processing sector on the example the dairy industry. The first part of the article analyzes various factors that stimulate and limit the transformation of the dairy industry towards the circular economy. The second part presents the examples of solutions corresponding to the idea of a circular economy that have been implemented or are planned to be implemented in dairy enterprises. This paper is an overview. It uses strategic EU and national documents, literature on the circular economy in agri- -food systems, as well as reports from the trade press presenting specific examples of the implementation of circular economy solutions in dairies. The analysis shows that in the dairy industry there are great opportunities to implement the circular economy model, but it is a complex process under the influence of stimulating and limiting factors. It requires systemic changes at various levels of the economy, significant financial resources, and above all, adaptation investments in the field of innovative technologies, energy systems, and water and wastewater management. Successful activities supporting the transformation towards the circular economy implemented in dairy enterprises include in particular solutions consisting in: reducing the amount of waste produced and reusing it, direct use of by-products, using renewable energy sources (in heating and cooling systems), reducing consumption of water and reusing it, using eco-friendly packaging and sustainable transportation. In conclusion, it should be stated that the actions taken by the food processing sector, including the dairy industry, aimed at transformation towards the circular economy are necessary, especially in the context of the challenges related to the European Green Deal and the Farm to Fork Strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了食品加工行业（以乳制品行业为例）应用循环经济模式的决定因素，指出乳制品行业虽具备实施循环经济的巨大潜力，但受多重因素影响，需系统性变革与大量投资。成功举措包括减少废弃物、再利用副产品、使用可再生能源、节约水资源、环保包装和可持续运输等。
AI.research_question: 在食品加工行业（以乳制品业为例）中，循环经济模式应用的决定因素是什么？哪些因素在刺激或限制乳制品行业向循环经济转型？
AI.motivation: 面对欧洲绿色协议和"从农场到餐桌"战略的挑战，食品加工行业向循环经济转型迫在眉睫。乳制品行业作为食品加工的重要部门，其转型潜力与障碍尚待系统梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论；农业食品系统可持续转型理论
AI.method: 综述性研究。使用欧盟及国家级战略文件、循环经济文献、行业贸易报告，分析乳制品企业已实施或计划实施的循环经济解决方案案例。
AI.findings: 1）乳制品行业实施循环经济潜力巨大但过程复杂，受刺激因素和限制因素双重影响；2）需系统性变革、大量资金投入及创新技术、能源系统、水与废水管理方面的适应性投资；3）成功实践包括减少废弃物、再利用副产品、使用可再生能源、减少并再利用水资源、环保包装和可持续运输。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了乳制品行业向循环经济转型的刺激因素与限制因素，为食品加工领域循环经济转型提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乳制品企业提供了可借鉴的循环经济实践案例（如废弃物减量、副产品直接利用、可再生能源使用、水资源管理、环保包装与可持续运输），并为政策制定者推动行业转型提供了参考依据。

title: Environmental, Organizational, and Economic Implications for Agriculture in Areas with Different Share of the Natura 2000 Network
affiliations: National Research Institute - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI)

detail.title: Environmental, Organizational, and Economic Implications for Agriculture in Areas with Different Share of the Natura 2000 Network
detail.abstract: The aim of the study is to assess environmental, organizational, and economic implications for agriculture in municipalities with different share of the Natura 2000 network in Poland. Data on the distribution of Natura 2000 sites and natural management conditions in municipalities are derived from the General Directorate for Environmental Protection and the Institute of Soil Science and Plant Cultivation State Research Institute for 2018. Data on the features of the organizational potential of agriculture across municipalities were collected from the Agency for Restructuring and Modernisation of Agriculture. They were generated on the basis of applications for direct payments under the 2016 and 2021 campaigns submitted by 1345.2 and 1269.5 thousand farms, i.e., the beneficiaries of the 2014-2020 common agricultural policy (CAP), respectively. It was found that municipalities with a large and particularly large share of Natura 2000 areas, as compared to municipalities without such areas, were characterized by significantly worse management conditions and a more diverse landscape, as well as a larger share in agricultural area with extensive production characteristic of high nature value farmlands (HNVf) designated in Poland under the 2014-2020 CAP. Farms located in Natura 2000 areas, as compared to other farms, were characterized by a larger average agricultural area, as well as by lower labor inputs per 1 ha of agricultural area. They were characterized by lower total costs, including direct costs, which resulted in lower factor productivity and income per 1 ha of agricultural area. The conclusion was that they had less development opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了波兰Natura 2000网络覆盖比例不同的 municipalities（市镇）在农业环境、组织和经济方面的差异。发现高覆盖率的市镇管理条件更差、景观更多样，农场面积更大但劳动力投入和成本更低，导致生产率和收入更低，发展机会更少。
AI.research_question: 波兰不同Natura 2000网络覆盖比例的市镇在农业的环境、组织和经济影响方面存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 评估Natura 2000保护区对不同覆盖程度市镇农业发展的具体影响，为欧盟共同农业政策（CAP）和农村发展政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业环境经济学、保护区对农业发展的影响理论、高自然价值 farmland（HNVf）概念。
AI.method: 利用波兰环境保护总局和土壤科学与植物栽培研究所2018年的数据，以及农业重组与现代化局收集的2016年和2021年直接支付申请数据（分别覆盖134.52万和126.95万个农场），对不同Natura 2000覆盖程度的市镇进行比较分析。
AI.findings: Natura 2000高覆盖市镇管理条件更差、景观更多样；HNVf占比更高；农场平均面积更大但劳动投入和总成本（含直接成本）更低；单位面积要素生产率和收入更低，发展机会更少。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了保护区对农业生产力和经济绩效影响的实证研究，为HNVf与Natura 2000重叠区域的农业特征提供了定量证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰及欧盟调整CAP补贴政策、针对Natura 2000区域内农场制定差异化支持措施提供了数据支撑和政策建议。

title: Effect of Foreign Farmers’ Presence on Poverty Status of Rural Farming Households in Nigeria
affiliations: University of Ilorin and University of Ilorin

detail.title: Effect of Foreign Farmers’ Presence on Poverty Status of Rural Farming Households in Nigeria
detail.abstract: In pursuing the government's goal of socioeconomic development and poverty reduction, some commercial foreign farmers were invited. Part of the expectation from this collaboration was to boost food production, create jobs for youth, and alleviate rural poverty. The aim of this study was to consider the spillover effect of the foreign farmers' presence on the poverty status of farming households in Kwara State, Nigeria. The population for the study comprises of all the farming households in Edu local government area. There was a random selection of 20 villages and 12 farming households from each village, summing 240 respondents. Analytical methods used were descriptive statistics and structural equation modeling (SEM). Results have shown that adoption index and household size are positively related to total revenue at a 1% level of significance, which indicated a strong influence of the adoption of foreign farmers' technology on the income of local farmers. It was concluded that it is a positive spillover effect of the presence of foreign farmers concerning the technological transfer, increased output with its positive effect on poverty far outweighs the displacement of farmlands. This should preferably be enhanced for better productivity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了尼日利亚夸拉州外国农民的存在对当地农户贫困状况的溢出效应。通过240个农户样本的SEM分析发现，采用外国农民技术显著提高了当地农民收入，产生了正向溢出效应，其收益超过了土地置换的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 外国农民的存在对尼日利亚夸拉州当地农户贫困状况产生怎样的溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚政府邀请商业外国农民参与本国社会经济发展和减贫目标，期望通过合作提高粮食产量、为青年创造就业并减轻农村贫困。然而，外国农民的存在对当地农户的实际影响（尤其是溢出效应）尚待实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 溢出效应理论（Spillover Effect）——外国农民的技术转让对本地农户产生正向或负向的外部性影响。
AI.method: 采用描述性统计和结构方程模型（SEM）分析240个农户样本数据（随机选取20个村庄，每村12户）。
AI.findings: （1）技术采纳指数和家庭规模与总收入在1%水平上显著正相关；（2）外国农民的技术转让对当地农民收入产生强烈正向影响；（3）正向溢出效应（技术转移、增产增收）远超过土地置换带来的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家外国农业投资对本地农户贫困影响的溢出效应提供了实证证据，验证了技术转让作为正向溢出渠道的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强外国农民与本地农户的技术合作与知识转移，以提升农业生产率和减贫效果；政策上应优先促进正向溢出效应，同时管理好土地置换等潜在负面影响。

title: Tendencies for Usage of Rapeseed Oil and Maize for Biocomponent Production in Poland Between 2015 and 2020
affiliations: Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute

detail.title: Tendencies for Usage of Rapeseed Oil and Maize for Biocomponent Production in Poland Between 2015 and 2020

keywords: Usage of Rapeseed Oil and Maize for Fuel Purposes

detail.abstract: The aim of the article is to present the supply and demand situation on the market of rapeseed oil and maize used for fuel purposes in Poland, as well as analyze the relationship between their prices and production, as well as the consumption of gasoline and diesel fuel. The analysis covered the 2015-2020 period and was based on data from statistics Poland, the National support Center for agriculture, and the Polish Oil industry and Trade Organization. statistical analysis showed that between 2015 and 2020 the dynamics of the usage of raw materials to produce biofuels exceeded the growth rate of their production and harvest. The assessment of the relationship between production and consumption of fuels in Poland showed that the demand from the fuel sector had a dominant influence on the prices of rapeseed oil and maize during the period under consideration, and fuel production had a less significant share in shaping wholesale prices of rapeseed oil and purchase prices of maize. Biofuels are an important and topical issue both in the context of the new energy policy of the european union (eu) and Poland until 2040 and Russia's invasion of ukraine, with one of the consequences being the energy crisis and the announcement of the eu becoming independent from Russian energy. in such a situation, biofuels and raw materials for their production may turn out to be an important element of improving energy security.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2015-2020年波兰菜籽油和玉米在生物燃料市场中的供需情况，发现燃料部门的需求对这两种原材料价格起主导作用，且生物燃料在欧盟能源独立战略中具有重要意义。
AI.research_question: 波兰用于燃料目的的菜籽油和玉米的市场供需状况如何？其价格与汽油、柴油的生产与消费之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 在欧盟新能源政策（至2040年）和俄乌冲突引发能源危机的背景下，生物燃料及其原料可能成为提升能源安全的关键要素，因此需要系统分析波兰相关市场动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供需理论；价格传导机制；生物燃料与化石燃料的替代关系理论。
AI.method: 基于波兰统计局、国家农业支持中心和波兰石油工业与贸易组织2015-2020年的数据，采用统计分析（动态增长率比较、价格与产量/消费关系评估）。
AI.findings: 1) 2015-2020年间，生物燃料原料（菜籽油和玉米）的使用量增速超过其生产和收获增速；2) 燃料部门的需求对菜籽油和玉米价格起主导作用；3) 生物燃料生产对菜籽油批发价格和玉米收购价格的影响相对较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生物燃料原料市场中"需求拉动"而非"供给推动"的价格形成机制，丰富了农业原料与能源市场关联性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰及欧盟在能源危机背景下制定生物燃料政策、保障能源安全提供了实证依据；提示政策制定者应关注燃料需求侧对农产品价格的影响。

title: Should We End the Fed? Can We?
affiliations: University of Mississippi and

detail.title: Should We End the Fed? Can We?
detail.abstract: Should we end the Fed? If so, can we? The first question is largely verboten among academic economists. We discuss the Fed's consequences for U.S. macroeconomic performance and its compatibility with basic democratic norms. The Fed's failure to improve macroeconomic outcomes and its tendency to exceed its legislative mandate suggest that economists are far too quick to dismiss the question of alternative monetary institutions. The second question is insufficiently examined by the Fed's critics. The key constraints are not domestic and economic but international and political. For decades, U.S. policy has promoted and maintained dollar dominance within the international monetary system. The Fed is a crucial institutional support for geopolitical goals. Eliminating the Fed would likely be inconsistent with those goals. Hence, major fiscal and strategic changes must precede any attempt to end the Fed.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑美联储的存废问题，认为美联储既未能显著改善宏观经济表现，又时常超越其立法授权，但废除美联储面临国际政治和美元霸权体系的重大约束，需要先进行财政和战略变革。
AI.research_question: 美联储是否应当被废除？如果应当，是否可能实现？
AI.motivation: 学术界对美联储存废问题的讨论近乎禁忌，而美联储的实际表现和民主规范兼容性值得重新审视；同时，批评者往往忽视了废除美联储所面临的真实约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济绩效评估、民主规范理论、国际货币体系与地缘政治理论。
AI.method: 规范性论证与制度分析，对美联储的宏观经济表现、立法授权边界、国际政治经济约束进行综合评估。
AI.findings: 美联储在改善宏观经济方面表现不佳，且倾向于超越立法授权；废除美联储的主要约束并非国内经济因素，而是国际政治层面——美元霸权是美国地缘政治目标的核心支撑，美联储是维持这一体系的关键制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了经济学界对美联储"不可质疑"的学术禁忌，提出废除美联储的关键障碍在于国际政治而非国内经济，将货币制度讨论置于地缘政治框架之中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策改革和替代性货币制度讨论提供了分析框架，指出任何废除美联储的尝试必须伴随先行的重大财政与战略变革。

title: Culture, Risk-taking, and Public Leadership: Evidence from Chinese Villages

detail.title: Culture, Risk-taking, and Public Leadership: Evidence from Chinese Villages
detail.abstract: Many societies preserve traditional culture tied to risk-taking. This paper shows the substantial impact of traditional risk-taking culture on public leadership and governance, leveraging widely-held zodiac beliefs about risk-avoidance in rural China, which follow an exogenous 12-year cycle tied to a person's birth year. Using a representative village panel, I find that village heads in their risk-avoidant zodiac years follow governance processes more and enhance villagers' perception about responsiveness. I also observe consistent expenditure changes, with higher public good spending and a comparable decline in administration spending that is prone to misuse. However, treated leaders are also less likely to promote policy innovation. These results can be most easily reconciled with a shift in village heads' risk-taking, which may yield a potential trade-off between accountability and public entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国农村的生肖信仰（每12年一个周期）作为外生冲击，发现处于"风险规避"生肖年的村官在治理中更注重流程合规、提升村民满意度，增加公共品支出并减少行政浪费，但同时也更不愿意推动政策创新。研究表明，传统文化中关于风险态度的信念会显著影响公共领导力与治理，并在问责制与公共创业精神之间形成潜在权衡。
AI.research_question: 传统的风险承担文化如何影响公共领导力和治理效果？
AI.motivation: 许多社会保留了与风险承担相关的传统文化，但这些文化如何影响公共治理尚不明确。本文利用中国农村关于生肖与风险规避的信仰，探究传统文化对领导行为和治理结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险承担文化、领导行为、公共治理、问责制与公共创业精神之间的权衡。
AI.method: 利用中国农村生肖信仰中的风险规避周期（每12年一个外生周期），结合代表性村庄面板数据，分析村官在其风险规避生肖年的治理行为变化。
AI.findings: （1）处于风险规避生肖年的村官更注重治理流程合规性，村民对政府回应性的感知提升；（2）公共品支出增加，而容易滥用行政支出显著下降；（3）但此类领导更不倾向于推动政策创新。结果可由领导者风险承担水平的变化解释，问责制与公共创业精神之间存在潜在权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次从传统文化中的风险信念切入，揭示了风险承担文化对公共领导力和治理的因果影响；（2）识别出问责制与公共创业精神之间的潜在权衡，丰富了公共管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提示政策制定者关注传统文化信念对基层治理的潜在影响；（2）为理解领导者在不同风险偏好下的行为差异提供了证据，有助于优化干部考核与激励机制。

title: Assessment of the Effectiveness of the School Fruit Scheme and School Fruit and Vegetables Scheme in Poland
affiliations: Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute and Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute

detail.title: Assessment of the Effectiveness of the School Fruit Scheme and School Fruit and Vegetables Scheme in Poland
detail.abstract: The growing health problems of the world's population related to inadequate nutrition have prompted many countries to take measures to develop healthy eating habits. One of the activities in the EU was the implementation of the School Fruit Scheme between 2009/10 and 2016/17, and School Fruit and Vegetables Scheme since 2017/18, in which fruit and vegetables have been one of the two components (the second component is milk and milk products). The aim of the article was to evaluate their effectiveness in terms of the consumption of fruit and vegetables in Polish families. The article was based on: EU legal acts, evaluations of the functioning and implementation of the schemes made by EU and Polish institutions, statistical data from Statistics Poland, and a review of the literature on the consumption of fruit and vegetables. It was found that despite the greater number of schools and children participating in the scheme and the growing expenses for its implementation, in most EU countries, including Poland, there is no increase in the consumption of horticultural products covered by the scheme (Pearson's correlation coefficient between the number of children participating in the scheme and consumption in households between 2009/10 and 2020/21 amounted to-0.77). The reasons may be the weaknesses of the scheme (i.e., generally poor quality of products, too short duration of the scheme, and also insufficient involvement of parents in its implementation) on the one hand and the influence of other factors determining the consumption of fruit and vegetables under the scheme being difficult to statistically confirm (greater availability of other products, ineffective advertising) on the other.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了欧盟学校果蔬计划在波兰的实施效果，发现尽管参与学校和儿童数量增加、支出增长，但波兰家庭果蔬消费并未提升（相关系数-0.77），原因包括计划本身缺陷（产品质量差、持续时间短、家长参与不足）以及其他因素（其他产品可得性高、广告效果不佳）。
AI.research_question: 欧盟学校果蔬计划在波兰的实施是否有效促进了家庭果蔬消费？
AI.motivation: 全球人口因营养不均衡导致的健康问题日益严重，许多国家采取措施培养健康饮食习惯。欧盟实施了学校果蔬计划，本文旨在评估该计划在波兰的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于营养健康政策评估理论，运用消费行为分析框架，探讨公共营养干预计划对家庭消费的影响机制。
AI.method: 研究基于欧盟法律文件、计划实施评估报告、波兰统计局数据以及文献综述，采用Pearson相关系数进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 参与计划的学校数量、儿童数量及支出逐年增长，但波兰家庭果蔬消费并未随之增加。参与儿童数量与家庭消费量之间的Pearson相关系数为-0.77，呈显著负相关。计划效果不彰的原因包括：产品质量不佳、计划持续时间过短、家长参与不足，以及其他因素如替代产品可得性高和广告效果不理想。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共营养干预政策的有效性评估提供了实证证据，揭示了政策投入与消费效果之间的脱节现象，丰富了营养政策评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了欧盟学校果蔬计划在波兰实施中的具体问题（产品质量、持续时间、家长参与），为政策优化提供了明确方向；同时提醒政策制定者需关注其他影响消费的因素，对各国推行类似营养干预计划具有参考价值。

title: Explaining versus Predicting Mutual Fund Returns: Machine Learning, Factor Attribution, and Market Efficiency
affiliations: University of Dundee

detail.title: Explaining versus Predicting Mutual Fund Returns: Machine Learning, Factor Attribution, and Market Efficiency
detail.abstract: Machine learning decomposes mutual fund returns with high fidelity but extracts no forward return signal-a boundary predicted by semi-strong market efficiency that no prior study has tested at this scale. Using 1,100 actively managed U.S. equity funds from January 2000 through December 2025, we evaluate fourteen model architectures on 54 publicly traded factor indices spanning equities, fixed income, commodities, and international assets. ElasticNet achieves 77.57% contemporaneous out-of-sample R², exceeding a Ridge OLS benchmark by 3.81 percentage points. Yet nine one-periodahead trading strategies produce an average annual return of 3.03% (average t-statistic = 1.41), with no strategy surviving multiple-testing adjustment. A contemporaneous quintile sort delivers a 64.69% annualized long-short spread that collapses to 2.41% in forward prediction-economically negligible and statistically indistinguishable from zero (t = 1.10). SHAP-based attribution further reveals that Morningstar style categories explain only 6.0% of cross-sectional factor-exposure variation, with 94.0% attributable to fund-specific heterogeneity, demonstrating that fund-level factor analysis materially dominates categorical classification for risk monitoring purposes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1,100只美国主动管理型权益基金（2000-2025年），检验了14种机器学习模型在54个因子指数上的表现。ElasticNet实现了77.57%的同期样本外R²，但所有前向预测策略均无法产生统计显著的超额收益，验证了半强式有效市场假说。同时，SHAP归因表明基金层面的因子分析远优于晨星风格分类的风险监控效果。
AI.research_question: 机器学习能否从共同基金收益率中分解出对未来回报有预测能力的信号？半强式有效市场假说在大规模基金数据中是否成立？
AI.motivation: 虽然机器学习能够以高保真度分解基金收益，但在大规模样本中检验其前向预测能力是否受限于半强式市场有效性的边界，此前尚无研究进行过如此规模的测试。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半强式有效市场假说（Semi-Strong Market Efficiency），因子模型分解，机器学习预测理论
AI.method: 使用14种机器学习模型架构（包括ElasticNet、Ridge OLS等），在54个公开交易的因子指数（涵盖股票、固定收益、商品和国际资产）上，基于1,100只美国主动管理型权益基金2000-2025年的数据进行分析。采用同期样本外R²评估拟合优度，构建9种一期前向交易策略评估预测能力，使用SHAP归因分析因子暴露的截面差异。
AI.findings: （1）ElasticNet实现77.57%的同期样本外R²，比Ridge OLS基准高出3.81个百分点；（2）9种一期前向交易策略平均年化收益仅3.03%，平均t值为1.41，无策略通过多重检验校正；（3）同期五分位排序的年化多空利差高达64.69%，但前向预测时骤降至2.41%，经济上可忽略且统计不显著（t=1.10）；（4）SHAP归因显示，晨星风格类别仅解释因子暴露截面变异的6.0%，94.0%归因于基金特异性异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大规模基金样本（1,100只）和长时间跨度（2000-2025年）上检验了半强式有效市场假说在机器学习基金收益分解中的边界，证明即使高保真度的因子分解也无法产生可预测的前向收益信号。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险监控实践提供了重要启示：基金层面的因子分析（而非依赖晨星风格分类）在解释因子暴露差异方面具有压倒性优势（94% vs 6%），建议投资者和监管机构采用细粒度的因子分析而非粗粒度的类别分类进行风险管理。

title: Agriculture in the Peripheries – The Kingdom of Bhutan
affiliations: Warsaw University of Life Sciences and Warsaw University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Agriculture in the Peripheries – The Kingdom of Bhutan
detail.abstract: The main aim of the paper is to familiarize the readers with the economy, and above all the agricultural sector of the kingdom of Bhutan. The direct inspiration for this paper was the ban on cage breeding of laying hens introduced in this country in 2012, which brings to mind an important event, which happened in 1972, when the king of Bhutan announced the concept of the Gross National happiness index (GNh). Figures and graphics presented in the article were prepared on the basis of Bhutan's national statistics and available publications. The structure of Bhutan's economy is dominated by the industrial and services sectors. the share of agriculture in generating GdP has ranged from 14 to 22% in the last twenty years, with employment in agriculture reaching almost 60% of the total workforce. the agricultural sector is highly fragmented, and at the same time vulnerable to threats resulting from difficult natural conditions and climate change. Bhutan is not achieving food self-sufficiency, despite strong support from Bhutanese authorities for the sector and increasing productivity. The changes taking place in agriculture and the entire economy of Bhutan are strongly oriented towards the implementation of the sustainable development paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了不丹王国的经济特别是农业部门概况，以2012年禁止笼养蛋鸡为切入点，探讨了不丹农业的碎片化、脆弱性及可持续发展导向。
AI.research_question: 不丹农业部门的结构特征、面临挑战及其在可持续发展范式下的转型路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 2012年不丹禁止笼养蛋鸡的政策引发了作者对该国农业及整体经济模式的关注，同时不丹提出的国民幸福指数（GNH）理念也构成了研究背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展范式、国民幸福指数（GNH）理念
AI.method: 基于不丹国家统计数据和已有出版物的描述性统计分析，辅以图表呈现。
AI.findings: 1. 工业和服务业主导不丹经济，农业GDP占比14-22%，但农业就业占比近60%；2. 农业高度碎片化，易受自然条件和气候变化威胁；3. 不丹未能实现粮食自给自足；4. 农业和整体经济强烈向可持续发展范式转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国民幸福指数（GNH）理念与农业可持续发展结合，丰富了可持续农业研究的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不丹及其他发展中国家在追求粮食安全与可持续发展平衡方面提供了实证参考；展示了禁止笼养蛋鸡等政策对农业转型的启示意义。

title: What Cadastral Tax Rate Should be Imposed on Farm Assets
affiliations: National Research Institute (PIB)

detail.title: What Cadastral Tax Rate Should be Imposed on Farm Assets
detail.abstract: The aim of the study was to determine cadastral tax rate calculated on farm assets, which would allow for replacing the current wealth taxes without increasing the tax burden for farms. The research was based on data from FADN (Farm Accountancy Data Network) farms. The method of financial analysis simulation was used. The research shows that the total wealth tax burden related to farm income is small. The taxes are the greatest burden to the income of very small farms whose economic size is between EUR 2,000 and 8,000 annually (7.37%) and farms dealing with field crops (4.36%). Meanwhile, farms dealing with horticulture (0.69%) and poultry production (0.54%), as well as large farms with an annual economic size of EUR 100,000–500,000 (1.93%) and very large farms with an economic size of more than EUR 500,000 (1.13%) currently pay relatively lower taxes. It was also found that significant changes occurred in the structure of farm assets. While in the 1970s the largest share (approx. 84%) of the assets of individual farms at that time concerned buildings, currently the share of buildings in assets decreased to approx. 19%. There is a relatively larger share of buildings in assets among farms specialized in horticulture and poultry amounting to 43.2 and 37.8%, respectively. The research allowed for determining the rate of a possible cadastral tax, while maintaining the current tax burden for farms. The tax rate may not exceed 0.22%. Relating it to the value of buildings, permanent crops, and land, it will not increase the current tax burden for farms.

title: Calibration-Aware Pneumonia Evaluation: A Reproducible Framework for Threshold Optimization, Reliability Assessment, and Structured Workflow Support
affiliations: Université de Moncton, Alfaisal University, University of Hail and National College Of Business Administration & Economics

detail.title: Calibration-Aware Pneumonia Evaluation: A Reproducible Framework for Threshold Optimization, Reliability Assessment, and Structured Workflow Support
detail.abstract: Chest X-ray pneumonia detection has been widely studied using deep learning, yet many evaluation pipelines remain focused mainly on discrimination metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, F1-score, and ROC-AUC. These metrics are important but insufficient for decision-support settings in which predicted probabilities should be calibrated, uncertainty should be recognized, and uncertain or high-risk cases should be routed toward appropriate workflow actions. This paper introduces a reproducible calibration-aware pneumonia evaluation framework that integrates predictive modeling, validation-optimized threshold selection, probability calibration, Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty estimation, and constrained multi-criteria workflow evaluation. The objective is not to propose a new state-of-the-art chest X-ray architecture, but to provide a reliability-oriented evaluation pipeline that connects model probabilities with calibrated confidence, threshold-sensitive behavior, uncertainty-aware safety analysis, and structured workflow support. The framework is evaluated on PneumoniaMNIST and further examined under external chest X-ray transferability validation. Temperature scaling preserved discrimination performance and ranking behaviour, but it did not reduce the reported test ECE relative to the raw model; this motivates interpreting calibration jointly with ranking preservation, NLL, MCE, and reliability plots rather than as a single-metric improvement.  A constrained multi-criteria decision-support layer translated calibrated pneumonia probability and predictive uncertainty into four workflow actions: low-risk monitoring, additional evidence acquisition, clinician-confirmed treatment, and escalation for high-risk uncertain cases.The proposed framework provides a transparent and reproducible route for evaluating pneumonia detection models beyond binary classification. By integrating calibration, uncertainty, threshold analysis, safety auditing, and workflowlevel interpretation, it supports more cautious and operationally meaningful assessment of chest X-ray AI decisionsupport systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可复现的、关注校准与不确定性的肺炎检测评估框架，超越传统二分类判别指标，整合概率校准、不确定性估计、阈值选择和多准则工作流评估，用于更可靠地评估胸部X光AI决策支持系统。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个超越传统判别指标、融合概率校准与不确定性估计的可靠性导向的肺炎检测评估框架？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习肺炎检测评估主要关注准确率、灵敏度、F1分数和ROC-AUC等判别指标，但这些指标不足以支持决策场景中对校准概率、不确定性识别以及高风险病例路由的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率校准理论（Temperature Scaling）、蒙特卡洛Dropout不确定性估计、约束多准则决策支持理论
AI.method: 集成预测建模、验证集优化阈值选择、概率校准（Temperature Scaling）、蒙特卡洛Dropout不确定性估计、约束多准则工作流评估；在PneumoniaMNIST和外部胸部X光迁移验证集上评估
AI.findings: Temperature Scaling保持了判别性能和排序行为，但并未降低测试集ECE；这促使需要将校准与排序保持、NLL、MCE和可靠性图联合解释，而非作为单一指标改进。约束多准则决策层将校准后的肺炎概率和预测不确定性转化为四种工作流动作：低风险监测、额外证据获取、临床医生确认治疗、高风险不确定病例升级处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了校准与排序保持需联合评估的观点，而非仅关注单一ECE指标；构建了将概率-不确定性转化为结构化工作流决策的理论连接。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个透明、可复现的评估框架，支持超越二分类的肺炎检测模型评估，整合校准、不确定性、阈值分析、安全审计和工作流级解释，有助于更审慎、更具操作意义的胸部X光AI决策支持系统评估。

title: The Costs of Leader Biases: Evidence from Superstitious Chinese Mayors
affiliations: and Renmin University of China - School of Applied Economics

detail.title: The Costs of Leader Biases: Evidence from Superstitious Chinese Mayors
detail.abstract: Throughout history, political leaders have not been immune to their subjective beliefs — ranging from denialism to superstitions — yet we lack systematic evidence on their economic consequences.  This paper documents the substantial impact of leaders' non-factual beliefs, leveraging enduring traditional Chinese superstitions about spaces, which enables us to link quasi-random, leader-specific variation to regional development in their cities. We find that municipal zones perceived as unfavorable to mayors have an average 2 percent lower GDP compared to other zones. Exploiting mayoral reports and administrative micro-data, we show greater disruption in local public investment as a key driver. Downstream changes in firms and households further amplify the loss, with a 6% decrease in firm entry, a 4% reduction in the productivity of remaining firms, and a small population decline. While better institutional environments mitigate these effects, campaign-style ideological training does not. Our back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests such non-factual beliefs of Chinese mayors are associated with at least a 0.1% annual GDP loss over the past two decades. Overall, our findings highlight leaders' subjective beliefs as a quantitatively important determinant of economic performance.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国传统的空间风水迷信，发现市长认为对其不利的城市区域GDP平均低2%，主要是通过扰乱地方公共投资传导，进而影响企业进入、生产率和人口，最终导致至少0.1%的年度GDP损失。
AI.research_question: 政治领导人的非事实性信念（如迷信、否认主义）会对经济绩效产生怎样的系统性影响？
AI.motivation: 历史上众多政治领导人受到非事实性信念（从否认主义到迷信）的影响，但缺乏对其经济后果的系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导人的主观信念理论；非事实性信念对公共资源配置与经济绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用中国传统的空间风水迷信，将准随机的、市长特定的信念变异与城市区域发展相链接；采用市级报告与行政微观数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）被认为对市长不利的城市区域GDP平均低2%；（2）主要机制是地方公共投资受到更大干扰；（3）下游企业进入减少6%，存活企业生产率降低4%，人口小幅下降；（4）更好的制度环境可缓解效应，但意识形态培训无效；（5）过去二十年至少导致0.1%的年度GDP损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了领导人非事实性信念对经济绩效的影响，将主观信念纳入经济决定因素的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了迷信等非理性信念在公共治理中的实际经济成本，为制度建设和领导人选拔提供参考依据。

title: Towards a Digital Knowledge Act: Mapping Policy Options for Legal Risk Mitigation
affiliations: Institute for Information Law (IViR), University of Amsterdam,  and

detail.title: Towards a Digital Knowledge Act: Mapping Policy Options for Legal Risk Mitigation

declarations.funderStatement: Research conducted between February 2025 and April 2026, carried out jointly by Dr. Kacper Szkalej, Etienne Valk and Prof. Dr. Martin Senftleben, Institute for Information Law (IViR), University of Amsterdam. Funding for this project was secured from COMMUNIA Association. The authors have conducted this study in complete academic independence.

detail.abstract:
Drawing on desk research, stakeholder interviews, and policy analysis, this report identifies and analyses the principal sources of copyright-related uncertainty in the EU copyright system and their implications for knowledge institutions. It considers both the legal framework and ways in which copyright may be strategically leveraged against institutions. Subsequently, the report identifies and evaluates legal mechanisms that may reduce copyright-related uncertainty and create a more predictable environment for knowledge institutions. These mechanisms are: (i) best-practice guidelines; (ii) an advisory and dispute settlement body; (iii) a liability privilege for diligent staff acting in good faith; (v) a country-of-origin rules for cross-border research; and (vi) measures against unfair contract terms. Each mechanism addresses a distinct source of legal uncertainty, yet together they may allow knowledge institutions to move away from a culture of defensive overcompliance towards a position of confident, lawful use of copyright flexibilities.


The report ultimately advances a reform agenda that builds on the existing copyright acquis, emphasising the importance of certainty, fairness, and equitable access to knowledge. Reforms should reaffirm copyright’s role as a facilitator of research and innovation and as a protector of the public interest. Without a coherent, enabling regulatory framework that explicitly recognises and mitigates legal risks, the work of the very institutions designed to drive educational and scientific advancement may be impeded. This, in turn, undermines the fundamental purpose of EU copyright law itself.


As the analysis shows, the plethora of conditions and limiting factors that accompany copyright provisions seeking to support teaching, research and the work of cultural heritage institutions casts doubt upon the effectiveness of these provisions in practice. The minimal degree of legal certainty offered by the provisions for knowledge institutions in EU copyright law raises serious doubts about the potential of the current rules to reconcile the competing fundamental rights at stake. In other words: without appropriate countermeasures, as proposed at the end of this report, the current EU copyright acquis in the field of teaching, research and cultural heritage may be unconstitutional.

AI.tldr: 本报告通过案头研究、利益相关者访谈和政策分析，识别了欧盟版权体系中知识机构面临的主要不确定性来源及其影响，评估了减少不确定性的法律机制（最佳实践指南、咨询与争端解决机构、善意员工责任豁免、跨境研究来源国规则、不公平合同条款措施），并提出了改革议程，强调版权应服务于研究和创新，否则现行版权法可能违宪。
AI.research_question: 欧盟版权体系中的哪些因素导致知识机构面临法律不确定性？哪些法律机制能够有效减少这种不确定性，为知识机构创造更可预测的环境？
AI.motivation: 知识机构（如高校、图书馆、文化遗产机构）在进行教学、研究和文化传承工作时，面临欧盟版权法带来的严重法律不确定性，导致防御性过度合规（defensive overcompliance）文化盛行，阻碍了教育和科学进步，这与版权法促进创新的根本目的相悖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律不确定性理论、版权法中的公共利益理论、基本权利平衡理论（知识产权 vs. 教育/科研自由）
AI.method: 案头研究（desk research）、利益相关者访谈（stakeholder interviews）、政策分析（policy analysis）
AI.findings: 1) 欧盟版权法中支持教学、研究和文化遗产机构工作的条款伴随大量条件和限制因素，削弱了这些条款在实践中的有效性。2) 现行版权条款为知识机构提供的法律确定性极低，引发对其在调和竞争性基本权利方面有效性的严重质疑。3) 若无适当对策，欧盟现行版权法在教学、研究和文化遗产领域可能违宪。4) 六种法律机制（最佳实践指南、咨询与争端解决机构、善意员工责任豁免、来源国规则、不公平合同条款措施）可共同帮助知识机构从防御性过度合规转向自信、合法地使用版权灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 从法律不确定性角度系统分析了欧盟版权法对知识机构的负面影响，揭示了版权体系中"条件与限制因素过多导致法律确定性不足"的悖论，并论证了现行法律可能因无法平衡竞争性基本权利而违宪的理论命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了六项具体可操作的法律机制建议，为欧盟立法者和政策制定者提供了改革路线图；帮助知识机构识别法律风险并寻求从防御性合规到自信合规的转变路径。

title: Too Negative to Believe? How Headline Sentiment Shapes Truth Judgments About Misinformation
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Psychological and Behavioural Science,  and London School of Economics

detail.title: Too Negative to Believe? How Headline Sentiment Shapes Truth Judgments About Misinformation

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval statement This study involved human participants and received ethics approval from the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) Research Ethics Committee. All participants provided informed consent prior to taking part in the study. Participation was voluntary, and respondents were informed of the purpose of the research, their right to withdraw, and the treatment of their data in accordance with applicable ethical and data protection requirements.

detail.abstract: Misinformation on social media is disproportionately negative in tone, yet whether the emotional framing of a headline causally affects belief remains an open question. We address this using a choice-based conjoint experiment in which 500 US respondents evaluated real headlines about Donald Trump's 2023indictment, formatted as Facebook posts. Headlines were randomly assigned values on four attributes: veracity, lexical sentiment, partisan bias, and social endorsement cues. We find that moderately negative sentiment increases belief in false claims by 11 percentage points with no comparable effect on true news, indicating that negativity functions as a credibility cue specific to misinformation. This effect is non-linear: extreme negativity reverses direction and triggers skepticism. Partisan framing uniformly reduces credibility, but the penalty falls disproportionately on outgroup-aligned headlines, consistent with information avoidance rather than concordanceseeking. Finally, likes attributed to friends increase belief in false headlines while decreasing belief in true ones. These findings establish that the words used to frame a claim, not only its factual content or source, shape truth judgments, with direct implications for platform design and media literacy interventions.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，社交媒体标题的负面情感框架会显著增加人们对虚假信息的相信程度（增加11个百分点），但对真实信息没有类似影响。这种效应是非线性的：极端负面反而会引发怀疑。此外，来自朋友的点赞会提高对虚假标题的信任，同时降低对真实标题的信任。
AI.research_question: 标题的情感框架是否以及如何因果性地影响人们对社交媒体信息的相信程度？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体上的错误信息在语调上 disproportionately 呈现负面倾向，但负面情感框架是否 causally 影响人们的信念判断，这一问题尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情感作为可信度线索理论；信息回避理论；非线性情感效应理论
AI.method: 基于选择的联合实验，500名美国受访者评估关于唐纳德·特朗普2023年起诉的真实新闻标题（呈现为Facebook帖子格式）。标题在四个属性上随机赋值：真实性、词汇情感、党派偏见和社交认可线索。
AI.findings: (1) 中等程度的负面情感使虚假信息被相信的概率增加11个百分点，但对真实信息无显著影响；(2) 极端负面情感反而会逆转方向，引发怀疑（非线性效应）；(3) 党派框架普遍降低可信度，但对反对派倾向的标题惩罚更重（信息回避而非寻求一致）；(4) 来自朋友的点赞增加对虚假标题的信任，同时降低对真实标题的信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 确立了负面情感作为专门针对虚假信息的可信度线索机制；发现了负面情感的非线性效应；区分了信息回避与一致性寻求两种机制在党派偏见中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 对平台设计和媒体素养干预措施有直接启示：应关注标题的情感框架（而非仅关注事实内容或来源）对真相判断的影响。

title: The Absence of Consensus and Restraint in US Trade Policy: Implications for the World Trading System
affiliations: Brooklyn Law School

detail.title: The Absence of Consensus and Restraint in US Trade Policy: Implications for the World Trading System
detail.abstract: The problem with US trade policy – for both the world trading system and the US itself – is the absence of consensus paired with a lack of meaningful legal restraint.  There is no political consensus on the aims of international trade.  There is limited legal restraint on what trade policies the president in power can pursue.  This combination has led to more than a decade of trade-policy whiplash unmoored from a coherent strategy.  If it endures, it will continue to cause damage to the US economy and alliance system, and to the world trading system itself.

AI.tldr: 美国贸易政策因缺乏政治共识和有意义的法律约束，导致十多年来的政策反复无常，损害了美国经济、联盟体系及全球贸易体系。
AI.research_question: 美国贸易政策为何出现反复无常（whiplash）？其根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国贸易政策长期缺乏一致性和稳定性，对国内经济和国际体系造成持续损害，亟需诊断问题根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治共识理论；法律约束理论；贸易政策制定中的行政权力与制度制衡。
AI.method: 概念分析与制度分析（基于对US贸易政策法律框架和政治过程的定性研究）。
AI.findings: 1. 美国缺少对国际贸易目标的政治共识；2. 总统可推行的贸易政策缺少实质性法律约束；3. 两者结合导致十余年的贸易政策"摆锤效应"（whiplash），缺乏连贯战略。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"政治共识缺失"与"法律约束不足"双重因素共同驱动贸易政策不稳定的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国贸易政策改革提供诊断框架，警示若放任现状将损害美国经济、联盟体系及全球贸易秩序。

title: Quantifying Tax-Drag Shelter Benefits in Roth Conversions: RMD Reduction and the Hidden Roth Contribution
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Quantifying Tax-Drag Shelter Benefits in Roth Conversions: RMD Reduction and the Hidden Roth Contribution
detail.abstract: Roth conversions generate alpha by sheltering assets from the tax drag inherent in taxable accounts, Tax-Drag Shelter (TDS). A Roth conversion involves two distinct planning decisions: whether to convert, and conditional on converting, whether conversion tax should be paid from Inside or Outside assets. These decisions generate two distinct tax-drag shelter alphas: RMD-reduction alpha (Conversion decision) and Synthetic Roth Contribution (SRC) alpha (Outside-settlement decision only).  Both alphas reduce to the valuation identity, 𝛼 = 𝑃 ⋅ 𝜇, where 𝑃 is sheltered principal and 𝜇 is the per-dollar present value of the yearly sheltered-vs-taxable distribution gap.  Embedding SECURE 2.0'S bounded owner-life and beneficiary distribution structure is the critical addition that closes the stream and admits closed-form present-value measurement of both alphas.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Roth转换如何通过避税产生超额收益（alpha），将避税效应分解为"RMD缩减alpha"和"合成Roth缴款alpha"，并推导出统一的估值公式，纳入SECURE 2.0法案的分配结构后得到闭合解。
AI.research_question: Roth转换如何通过避税产生alpha？两种转换决策（是否转换、用内部还是外部资产缴税）分别产生怎样的alpha？如何对alpha进行精确估值？
AI.motivation: Roth转换的税收效益虽被广泛讨论，但缺乏将其系统分解为不同alpha来源并给出闭合形式估值的理论框架，SECURE 2.0法案的出台进一步要求更新估值模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税负避税理论（Tax-Drag Shelter, TDS）；估值恒等式 α = P · μ，其中P为避税本金，μ为每美元避税本金每年产生的避税与应税账户分配差额的现值。
AI.method: 理论推导建模，结合SECURE 2.0法案的有限所有者寿命与受益人分配结构，推导闭合形式现值测量公式。
AI.findings: Roth转换产生两种alpha：1）RMD缩减alpha（来自是否转换的决定）；2）合成Roth缴款（SRC）alpha（来自用外部资产缴税的决定）。两种alpha均统一于估值恒等式 α = P · μ。SECURE 2.0的有限期限结构是获得闭合解的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Roth转换的税收效益系统分解为两个独立的alpha来源，并建立统一的闭合形式估值框架，整合了SECURE 2.0法案的制度特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人投资者和财务顾问提供精准量化Roth转换税收效益的工具，帮助优化退休规划中的转换决策及缴税资金来源选择。

title: Mechanism Design over Magnitude: A Multi-Jurisdiction Evaluation of Carrot-Policy Effectiveness in Clean-Hydrogen Implementation

detail.title: Mechanism Design over Magnitude: A Multi-Jurisdiction Evaluation of Carrot-Policy Effectiveness in Clean-Hydrogen Implementation
detail.abstract:
We evaluate six major clean-hydrogen policy interventions across four jurisdictions (US 45Q, US 45V three-pillars NPRM, EU Innovation Fund, EU CBAM, UK Track-1, China 14th Five-Year Plan) using a project-level panel of 1,354 announced hydrogen developments from the S&P Global Hydrogen Project Database (2010– 2026). Treatment effects on cumulative cancellation probability are estimated using modern difference-in-differences estimators (Sun–Abraham IW, Borusyak–Jaravel– Spiess imputation, IPWRA matching, Synthetic DiD, Causal Forests, and Deaner– Ku hazard DiD) and accompanied by Rambachan–Roth honest-sensitivity bounds. 
Three substantive findings emerge. First, the magnitude ranking of policy effects (China 14th FYP > US 45Q > UK Track-1 ≫ EU Innovation Fund) systematically follows the number of economic frictions each instrument addresses, not the perunit monetary value of the subsidy. The China FYP estimate of −4.5 percentage points (honest-DiD breakdown M∗ = 1.5) exceeds the US 45Q estimate of −3.4 percentage points (M∗ = 0.2) despite comparable per-unit subsidy value, consistent with multi-friction mechanism dominance. Second, two informative nulls are identified: the EU Innovation Fund produces a precise null across six convergent estimators, and the EU CBAM produces a precise null across eight convergent estimators. The substantive interpretation is that the financing-constraint friction is not binding in the contemporary capital-abundant hydrogen environment, and that border-adjustment transmission to project-level investment decisions is weak in the early-implementation phase. Third, the US 45V three-pillars NPRM tripledifference estimate of +0.285 on US-Green cancellation hazard identifies friction amplification by policy design — the cleanest empirical test of perverse-direction κ-channel effects in the sample.
The methodological contribution is a pre-registered mechanism-falsifiability framework that disciplines mechanism interpretation against post-hoc rationalisation, combined with multi-method triangulation that strengthens both confirmatory and informative-null inferences. The policy implication is that reform of capex-grant instruments such as the EU Innovation Fund should incorporate offtake-commitment eligibility requirements, jointly addressing both financing and counterparty-risk frictions.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了美、欧、英、中四大司法辖区的六项清洁氢能政策对1,354个已宣布氢能项目累积取消概率的因果效应。主要发现：政策效果排序（中国十四五规划＞美国45Q＞英国Track-1＞欧盟创新基金）遵循"解决经济摩擦数量"而非补贴金额逻辑；EU创新基金和CBAM产生精确零效应；美国45V三支柱NPRM通过政策设计放大了摩擦。方法论贡献是预注册的机制可证伪框架与多方法三角验证。
AI.research_question: 六大清洁氢能政策干预对项目级累积取消概率的因果效应如何？政策效果的排序逻辑是什么？
AI.motivation: 清洁氢能投资承诺与最终投资决策之间存在巨大差距（"宣布-落地缺口"），现有研究缺乏对不同政策工具在项目层面因果效应的系统比较，尤其是政策设计如何通过影响经济摩擦来改变项目取消概率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多摩擦机制理论（多重市场失灵视角）；政策设计经济学（κ-渠道效应，即政策可能反向放大摩擦的机制）；Honest DiD框架（平行趋势偏离下的敏感性分析）。
AI.method: 使用S&P Global氢能项目数据库（2010-2026年）中1,354个已宣布项目的面板数据，采用六种现代双重差分估计量（Sun-Abraham交互加权、Borusyak-Jaravel-Spiess插补、IPWRA匹配、合成DID、因果森林、Deaner-Ku风险DID），并结合Rambachan-Roth诚实敏感性边界进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 政策效果排序：中国十四五规划（-4.5pp）＞美国45Q（-3.4pp）＞英国Track-1＞EU创新基金（精确零效应）；2. EU CBAM产生精确零效应，表明边境调节机制在早期实施阶段对项目投资决策的传导较弱；3. 美国45V三支柱NPRM的三重差分估计为+0.285，表明政策设计反向放大了取消风险（摩擦放大效应）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在项目层面系统比较多种清洁氢能政策工具的因果效应；提出并验证了"政策效果取决于解决经济摩擦数量而非补贴金额"的机制假说；识别出"融资约束摩擦非约束性"和"边境调节传导弱"两个信息性零效应；发现政策设计可能产生"摩擦放大"的逆向渠道效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 对EU创新基金等资本补贴工具的改革建议：应纳入承购承诺资格要求，同时解决融资和对手方风险两种摩擦；为政策制定者提供了不同政策工具效果排序的实证依据，指导更有效的氢能政策设计。

title: Rural urbanization in India: A Review of Drivers, Spatial Transformation and Socio-Economic Implications
affiliations: Lotus Valley International School

detail.title: Rural urbanization in India: A Review of Drivers, Spatial Transformation and Socio-Economic Implications
detail.abstract: Rural urbanization is a product of numerous push and pull factors that result in the conversion of formerly rural settlements into urban or urban-resembling towns or cities. The process of rural urbanization is essential for fostering inclusive growth, in both formerly rural areas and pre-existing urban metropolises. This is especially significant in a country like India, where the process of rural urbanization is said to be a key factor for bridging the income and opportunity gap which agricultural rural settlements face. Urbanization brings about development of infrastructure, administration and public facilities, and hence, improves the quality and standard of life of the former villagers, as well as migrants attracted by the urbanization and the subsequent growth in job opportunities. This paper highlights the drivers, spatial changes and socioeconomic consequences of rural urbanization, along with an analyses of the schemes supporting it. Using more than 100 publications on similar or related topics, this paper provides an excellent conceptualization of rural urbanization, from its basic meaning to its socioeconomic implications on the original population of the rural region. The stratification of the paper into 4 broad parts: Drivers of Rural Urbanization, Aspects of Rural Urbanization, Socio Economic Effects and Challenges makes the paper an easily navigable and detailed piece of literature. This review paper aims to compile stratified literature on this topic into one, complete and multi-faceted study on rural urbanization.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了印度农村城市化的驱动力、空间变化、社会经济后果及支持方案，基于100余篇文献构建了多维度分析框架。
AI.research_question: 农村城市化的驱动因素、空间变化及社会经济影响是什么？印度支持农村城市化的政策方案如何发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 农村城市化对于缩小城乡收入与机会差距至关重要，尤其在印度这样的发展中国家，缺乏对这一过程系统性、多层面的文献综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 推拉理论（push-pull factors）、城市化与包容性增长理论、空间转型理论
AI.method: 基于100余篇相关文献的系统综述，将内容分为四大板块：驱动因素、空间变化方面、社会经济影响及挑战。
AI.findings: 农村城市化由多种推拉因素驱动，带来基础设施、行政管理和公共设施的发展，改善原住民及移民的生活质量，但也伴随一系列社会经济挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 从基本概念到社会经济影响的完整概念化，提供了农村城市化的多维度、层次化分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了农村城市化驱动因素、效果及挑战的系统认识，有助于优化支持性政策方案的设计与实施。

title: Hedge Funds as Risk-Transforming Instruments in Institutional Portfolios: A Risk Budgeting Framework Beyond Traditional Metrics

detail.title: Hedge Funds as Risk-Transforming Instruments in Institutional Portfolios: A Risk Budgeting Framework Beyond Traditional Metrics
detail.abstract:
Hedge funds continue to occupy a contested yet persistent role in institutional portfolios despite long-standing concerns over fees, performance, and diversification benefits. Traditional allocation frameworks evaluate hedge funds primarily through conventional quantitative metrics and benchmark-relative returns, often leading to misaligned expectations and ambiguous assessments of value. This paper argues that such approaches are incomplete and inadequate as a primary organizing principle for hedge fund allocation.

The paper reframes hedge funds as risk-transforming tools rather than a homogeneous asset class and introduces a risk budgeting framework beyond traditional metrics. Under this approach, hedge fund strategies are evaluated according to the specific portfolio risks they are intended to mitigate, reshape, or deliberately accept in pursuit of other portfolio objectives — such as volatility exposure, drawdown tolerance, liquidity risk, tail risk, and governance risk — rather than their behavior as measured by traditional metrics relative to traditional assets. Particular attention is given to governance-oriented and control strategies, which operate through governance as risk mitigation and are poorly captured by traditional metric-based models.

Drawing on institutional allocator practice and governance-focused investment contexts, the paper demonstrates how risk budgeting improves capital allocation coherence, strengthens fiduciary oversight, and clarifies performance evaluation. By shifting the focus from asset categories to risk intent, the framework meaningfully improves how institutions think about hedge funds and offers a more resilient approach to portfolio construction in complex investment environments.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了传统的对冲基金配置框架（依赖量化指标和基准相对收益），提出应将对冲基金重新定义为风险转化工具，并引入风险预算框架，根据对冲基金旨在缓解、重塑或有意承担的特定投资组合风险（如波动性、回撤容忍度、流动性风险、尾部风险和治理风险）来评估策略，特别关注治理导向策略。该框架能提高资本配置连贯性、强化受托监督并优化绩效评估。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个超越传统量化指标和基准相对收益的对冲基金配置框架，从而更有效地评估对冲基金在投资组合中的价值？
AI.motivation: 传统框架依赖量化指标和基准相对收益来评估对冲基金，导致期望错位和价值评估模糊，无法充分捕捉对冲基金作为风险转化工具的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险预算框架；对冲基金作为风险转化工具（而非同质资产类别）；治理风险与治理导向策略理论。
AI.method: 概念性论证，结合机构配置实践和治理导向的投资情境进行框架推导与演示。
AI.findings: 风险预算框架能提高资本配置的连贯性、强化受托监督职责、澄清绩效评估标准；将焦点从资产类别转向风险意图，有助于改善机构对对冲基金的认知并构建更具韧性的投资组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 将对冲基金重新定义为风险转化工具而非同质资产类别；提出风险预算框架以替代传统量化指标，拓宽了对冲基金评估的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供更清晰的资本配置逻辑、更强的受托监督能力以及更精准的绩效评估方法；特别为治理导向和控制策略提供了传统模型无法捕捉的评估途径。

title: Market Fragmentation: Liquidity, Price Discovery, and Welfare
affiliations: London School of Economics - Department of Finance and Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science (AMSS)

detail.title: Market Fragmentation: Liquidity, Price Discovery, and Welfare
detail.abstract: We analyze the impact of financial market fragmentation when traders differ in terms of market access and information about the asset payoff. Agents who cannot operate on all trading venues are hurt by fragmentation. Those who can trade globally can benefit. Overall liquidity peaks at an intermediate level of fragmentation; price informativeness continues to improve until a higher level. A larger investor base and less information asymmetry widen the scope for beneficial fragmentation, while greater multi-venue access narrows it. The model explains the observed non-monotonic relationship between fragmentation and liquidity, and the differential impact on large-cap versus small-cap stocks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了金融市场碎片化对具有不同市场准入和信息优势的交易者的影响，发现碎片化对流动性呈非单调影响，对价格信息效率有正向作用，并解释了为何大盘股和小盘股受碎片化影响不同。
AI.research_question: 金融市场碎片化如何影响不同市场准入和信息禀赋的交易者，以及其对流动性、价格信息效率的综合影响？
AI.motivation: 现实中金融市场存在碎片化现象（如多个交易场所并存），且实证研究表明碎片化与流动性之间存在非单调关系，不同规模的股票受影响程度不同，需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称模型、市场微观结构理论、金融中介理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，考察不同市场准入和信息优势的交易者在碎片化市场中的均衡行为。
AI.findings: 1. 无法跨平台交易者受损，能全球交易者受益；2. 流动性在中等碎片化程度达到峰值；3. 价格信息效率在更高碎片化水平仍持续改善；4. 更大的投资者基础和更少的信息不对称扩大碎片化益处，而多平台准入缩小之；5. 模型解释了碎片化与流动性的非单调关系及大/小盘股差异影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融市场碎片化与流动性的非单调关系提供了理论解释，丰富了市场微观结构理论中关于市场准入与信息不对称交叉作用的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管层设计最优市场结构、平衡碎片化程度具有指导意义，有助于理解不同规模股票在碎片化环境中的差异化表现。

title: Relative Skills in the Classroom: Teachers' Gender-Differentiated Impacts on Test Scores and Course Grades

detail.title: Relative Skills in the Classroom: Teachers' Gender-Differentiated Impacts on Test Scores and Course Grades
detail.abstract: Gender gaps in academic achievement vary across subjects and assessment types: girls outperform boys on teacher-assigned course grades and on standardized reading tests, while gaps in math test scores favor boys in early grades but reverse by middle school. I investigate how teachers' impacts on these outcomes differ for boys and girls, and what explains the heterogeneity. Using longitudinal administrative data from North Carolina, I estimate value-added measures for fifth-grade teachers separately for test scores and course grades, and find that they have systematically different impacts by student gender: teachers with high test-score value-added disproportionately benefit girls' test scores and course grades, while teachers with high course-grade value-added disproportionately benefit boys' test scores and course grades. I develop a two-factor model wherein unobserved cognitive and non-cognitive skills combine in different proportions to produce observed test scores and course grades, with test scores placing a higher weight on cognitive skills than grades. Under this framework, observed gender gaps imply that boys have a relative proficiency in cognitive skills and girls have a relative proficiency in non-cognitive skills. A teacher's effectiveness for a given skill dimension has (a) larger impacts on outcomes that use that skill more intensively, and (b) for students with a relative deficiency in that skill. In addition to predicting the gender-differentiated impacts, the framework predicts that teachers should have heterogeneous impacts connected to students' relative skill standing-independent of gender-a prediction consistent with a student-level test. The effects of course-grade value-added extend to high school: fifth-grade teachers with high course-grade value-added increase boys' likelihood of graduating high school, with no measurable effect for girls. These findings link multidimensional teacher effectiveness with multidimensional gender gaps in student achievement, suggesting that teacher effectiveness is not a single attribute and that its multidimensionality matters for which students benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究教师效能如何因学生性别而异，发现教师对考试成绩和课程成绩的影响存在系统性性别差异：高考试成绩增值的教师更有利于女生的成绩，而高课程成绩增值的教师更有利于男生的成绩。作者构建了认知与非认知技能的双因素模型来解释这一现象，并发现教师对课程成绩的影响能延续到高中阶段，提高男生的毕业率。
AI.research_question: 教师对不同性别学生的影响是否存在系统性差异？是什么解释了这些异质性？
AI.motivation: 学业成就的性别差距因科目和评估类型而异，但教师如何影响这些差距尚不清楚。理解这一机制对于设计更公平的教育政策和教师评估体系至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双因素模型：学生拥有未观测到的认知技能和非认知技能，两者以不同比例组合产生考试成绩和课程成绩。考试成绩对认知技能的权重更高。教师对不同技能维度的有效性，(a)对更密集使用该技能的结果影响更大，(b)对在该技能上相对不足的学生影响更大。
AI.method: 使用北卡罗来纳州纵向行政数据，分别估计五年级教师对考试成绩和课程成绩的增值效应（value-added），并分析这些效应如何因学生性别而异。同时进行学生层面的检验以验证模型预测。
AI.findings: 1) 教师对考试成绩和课程成绩的增值效应存在系统性性别差异：高考试成绩增值的教师更有利于女生的成绩，高课程成绩增值的教师更有利于男生的成绩。2) 模型预测除了性别差异外，教师应具有与学生相对技能水平相关（而非性别）的异质性影响，这一预测得到验证。3) 五年级教师课程成绩的增值效应可延续到高中：高课程成绩增值的教师能提高男生的高中毕业率，但对女生无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将教师效能的多维性与学业成就的性别差距联系起来，表明教师效能并非单一属性，其多维性决定了哪些学生能够受益。构建的双因素模型为理解教师影响和学生表现的性别差异提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对教师评估和培训具有启示意义：教师评估不应仅基于考试成绩增值，还应考虑课程成绩等维度，否则可能导致对男生或女生产生系统性偏误。此外，提高教师的非认知技能培养能力可能有助于缩小教育结果的性别差距。

title: Credit Commitments by Nonbanks
affiliations: Texas A&M University and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Finance Department

detail.title: Credit Commitments by Nonbanks
detail.abstract: Despite the secular shift to nonbank lending, banks retain a distinctive advantage in providing credit lines (Kashyap, Rajan, and Stein, 2002). We document a new pattern in nonbank lending: business development companies (BDCs) extend substantial credit commitments to borrowers, with commitment-to-asset ratios comparable to those of banks. These off-balance-sheet commitments are concentrated, exposing BDCs to undiversified borrower liquidity shocks---a risk they manage with credit lines provided by banks. We develop a model of layered liquidity insurance along the credit chain: the BDC pools its portfolio firms to partially diversify idiosyncratic shocks and uses a bank credit line to backstop residual liquidity risk. In equilibrium, the nonbank optimally provides only partial liquidity insurance, which generates a novel externality whereby firms sharing the constrained liquidity pool inefficiently underinvest in liquidity management.

AI.tldr: 本文发现商业发展公司（BDCs）向借款人提供了大量信贷承诺，其承诺与资产比率与银行相当。这些表外承诺高度集中，使BDCs面临未分散的借款人流动性冲击风险，而它们通过银行信贷额度来管理这一风险。作者构建了一个信贷链条上的分层流动性保险模型，揭示了非银行机构仅提供部分流动性保险导致的企业流动性管理投资不足的外部性问题。
AI.research_question: 非银行金融机构（特别是商业发展公司BDCs）在提供信贷承诺时，如何通过银行信贷额度来管理集中的流动性风险？这种分层流动性保险机制会产生怎样的均衡结果和效率问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管金融体系呈现向非银行贷款的长期趋势，但银行在提供信贷额度方面仍具有独特优势。然而，新出现的证据表明非银行机构（如BDCs）也在大量提供信贷承诺，其运作模式与风险管理机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层流动性保险理论、信贷链条（credit chain）分析、流动性池约束下的外部性理论、不完全流动性保险模型
AI.method: 理论建模：构建了一个分层流动性保险模型，其中BDC通过汇集其投资组合公司来部分分散异质性冲击，并使用银行信贷额度来支撑剩余的流动性风险。
AI.findings: 1. BDCs的信贷承诺与资产比率与银行相当；2. 这些表外承诺高度集中，使BDCs面临未充分分散的流动性风险；3. BDCs通过银行提供的信贷额度来管理这些风险；4. 非银行机构在均衡中仅提供部分流动性保险，这产生了新的外部性——共享受限流动性池的企业在流动性管理上投资不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并形式化了"信贷链条上的分层流动性保险"概念，揭示了非银行机构提供部分流动性保险时产生的独特外部性机制，拓展了关于金融中介流动性保险功能的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解非银行金融机构在信贷市场中的风险管理实践和潜在系统性风险，为监管机构评估影子银行体系的流动性风险传导机制提供理论依据。

title: Equilibrium in Selection Markets with Finitely Many Contracts
affiliations: London School of Economics

detail.title: Equilibrium in Selection Markets with Finitely Many Contracts
detail.abstract: Empirical work on adverse selection often represents equilibrium through demand and average-cost curves for a single contract. This paper extends that approach to markets with finitely many contracts, where the demand and average cost of each contract depend on the prices of all contracts. I define such a price-taking equilibrium, which always exists and admits a complementarity characterization. I also show that standard equilibrium concepts, developed for settings with vertically differentiated contracts, often fail with horizontally differentiated contracts. In simple Hotelling-style examples, Nash, Riley, and Miyazaki-Wilson-Spence (MWS) equilibria may not exist. MWS may not exist even in settings with Nash equilibria, and dynamic withdrawal games may select different allocations from any static concept.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了逆向选择中单一合同的均衡表示方法，提出了多合同市场的价格接受均衡概念。研究发现，在水平差异化合同市场中，传统均衡概念（如Nash、Riley和MWS均衡）可能不存在，且动态退出博弈选择的配置与静态概念不同。
AI.research_question: 如何将逆向选择中基于需求曲线和平均成本曲线的单一合同均衡方法扩展到多合同市场？
AI.motivation: 现有逆向选择实证工作通常只考虑单一合同的均衡表示，但现实市场中存在多个合同且价格相互依赖，需要更一般的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆向选择理论、价格接受均衡、互补性理论；对比分析了Nash均衡、Riley均衡、MWS均衡等经典概念。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析，通过Hotelling-style例子进行对比检验。
AI.findings: (1) 定义了多合同市场的价格接受均衡，该均衡总是存在且具有互补性特征；(2) 在水平差异化合同市场中，Nash、Riley和MWS均衡可能不存在；(3) 即使存在Nash均衡，MWS均衡也可能不存在；(4) 动态退出博弈可能选择与任何静态概念不同的配置。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将逆向选择的单一合同均衡方法扩展到多合同场景；(2) 揭示了水平差异化与垂直差异化合同在均衡存在性上的本质差异；(3) 指出了经典均衡概念在水平差异化市场中的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为逆向选择市场的实证研究提供了更一般的均衡分析工具，提醒研究者注意水平差异化市场中传统均衡概念的适用边界。

title: Mortality from Birth through Adolescence: Trends, Determinants, and Insights from a Longitudinal Cohort in Benin
affiliations: Sorbonne University, Centre Hospitalier de Saint-Denis, Mother and Child Teaching Hospital, Université Paris Cité, Université de Rennes 1, Institut de Recherche Clinique du Bénin and Université de Rennes 1

detail.title: Mortality from Birth through Adolescence: Trends, Determinants, and Insights from a Longitudinal Cohort in Benin

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval for all studies referenced in this article was granted by the Institutional Review Boards of the Beninese Ethical Committee of the Faculté des Sciences de la Santé (FSS), the Committee of Ethical Research of the Institut des Sciences Biomédicales Appliquées (CER-ISBA) in Benin, and the Consultative Ethics Committee of the Research Institute for Development (IRD) in France. Written informed consent was obtained from all participants, with thumbprints provided by those unable to read or write. Neonates were enrolled in the MiPPAD child cohort with separate consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was funded by the European Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP; IP.2007.31080.002) and by the Fondation de France (grant number 00060746 2015).

detail.abstract:
Background: Despite substantial global progress, child mortality remains a major public health burden, with sub-Saharan Africa disproportionately affected. In West Africa, deaths from preventable causes remain alarmingly high, yet longitudinal evidence on the rates and risk factors of child mortality in the region is scarce. This study is among the first in Benin to examine child mortality from birth to 14 years in a community-based, longitudinal cohort.

Methods: Data originate from the Malaria in Pregnancy Preventive Alternative Drugs (MiPPAD) trial (NCT00811421), an open-label, randomized controlled trial that recruited pregnant women in their second trimester across four sub-Saharan African countries between September 2009 and December 2012. This analysis uses data from 1183 women enrolled at three health centers in the semi-rural Allada district of Benin, with offspring follow-up at 1, 9, and 12 months, 6 years, and 13–14 years.

Findings: Among 1093 live births, 99 deaths were recorded between birth and 14 years of follow-up, alongside 44 stillbirths and 10 spontaneous abortions. The majority of deaths occurred within the first six years of life: 22 (22∙2%) in the neonatal period, 34 (34∙3%)  between 28 days and 12 months, and 37 (37∙4%) between one and six years, with only 6 (6∙1%)  deaths between six and 14 years. Respiratory distress was the predominant cause of neonatal death (81%), with half of those babies having low birthweight (<2500 g). Beyond 28 days, malaria became the leading cause, accounting for 45% of deaths between 28 days and 14 years. In adjusted analyses, having a previous live birth was associated with reduced overall mortality (RR 0∙52, 95% CI 0∙29, 0∙94) while low birthweight (<2500 grams) was associated with elevated risk (RR 2∙32, 95% CI 1∙44, 3∙73).

Interpretation: Child mortality in this semi-rural Beninese cohort was concentrated in early life and driven primarily by respiratory distress in the neonatal period and malaria thereafter. These findings underscore the need for strengthened neonatal care infrastructure, expanded preterm birth support, and scaled-up malaria prevention strategies targeting young children — priorities critical for advancing progress toward SDG 3∙2 in West Africa.

AI.tldr: 基于贝宁半农村地区长达14年的纵向队列数据，本研究发现儿童死亡主要集中在生命早期，新生儿期主要死因为呼吸窘迫，之后疟疾成为首要死因。低出生体重显著增加死亡风险，而既往活产史具有保护作用。研究强调加强新生儿护理、扩大早产支持及扩大疟疾预防对实现西非可持续发展目标至关重要。
AI.research_question: 在西非贝宁半农村地区，0-14岁儿童死亡的发生率、时间分布、死因构成及风险因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球儿童死亡率有所下降，但西非地区可预防原因导致的死亡仍居高不下，而该地区缺乏基于社区纵向队列的儿童死亡率及风险因素的长期证据。这是贝宁首批从出生追踪至14岁的社区队列研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童生存理论、生命早期死亡风险的时间动态分布、新生儿与产后死亡病因学差异、低出生体重与既往生育史对儿童存活的影响机制。
AI.method: 数据来源于MiPPAD随机对照试验（NCT00811421）的贝宁Allada地区1183名孕妇，对其后代在1、9、12个月、6年和13-14岁进行随访。分析了1093名活产儿中99例死亡的死因分布，采用调整后的风险比评估风险因素。
AI.findings: 1093名活产儿中99例死亡，44例死产，10例自然流产。死亡集中在6岁前：新生儿期22例（22.2%），28天至12个月34例（34.3%），1-6岁37例（37.4%），6-14年仅6例（6.1%）。新生儿期死因以呼吸窘迫为主（81%），其中一半为低出生体重。28天后疟疾成为首要死因（占45%）。既往活产史降低总体死亡风险（RR 0.52），低出生体重增加风险（RR 2.32）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了贝宁半农村地区从出生到14岁的纵向儿童死亡率证据，揭示了新生儿期呼吸窘迫与之后疟疾主导的双阶段死因模式，明确了低出生体重和既往活产史在当地背景下的风险效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西非地区实现SDG 3.2目标提供了实证依据，指出需优先加强新生儿护理基础设施建设、扩大早产儿支持项目，并针对幼儿扩大疟疾预防策略。

title: Time-Varying Predictors of Stroke Following Transient Ischaemic Attack: A National Population-Based Cohort Study Using 50 Years of Linked Healthcare Data in Wales, UK
affiliations: Cardiff Metropolitan University, Cardiff Metropolitan University, Swansea University, Swansea University - Swansea University Medical School, Cardiff Metropolitan University and Cardiff Metropolitan University

detail.title: Time-Varying Predictors of Stroke Following Transient Ischaemic Attack: A National Population-Based Cohort Study Using 50 Years of Linked Healthcare Data in Wales, UK

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the Cardiff Metropolitan University Ethics Committee (UEC; approval ID: sta-7725) and the SAIL Information Governance Review Panel (IGRP; approval number: 1494) and is reported in accordance with STROBE guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: The PREDICT-EV project was funded by the Stroke Association (grant number: SA PG 23/100004).

detail.abstract:
Background: Transient ischaemic attack (TIA) confers a high risk of subsequent stroke. Population-level evidence describing how stroke risk after TIA evolves over time is needed to inform effective secondary prevention.

Methods: We conducted a national population-based retrospective cohort study of adults with a recorded TIA event in Wales. Time to first subsequent stroke was modelled using multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression and follow-up was split into prespecified intervals (0–7, 8–30, 31–365, and >365 days) to estimate interval-specific associations. Sensitivity analyses were conducted using a generalised linear mixed-effects model (GLMER).

Findings: Among 40,957 individuals with a recorded TIA event, 10,572 (25.8%) had a subsequent stroke. Stroke risk since TIA varied over time. Increasing age was associated with progressively higher stroke risk, particularly beyond one year (75–84 years vs 18–44 years: HR 2.25, 95% CI 1.80–2.81). Diabetes was associated with persistently elevated stroke risk across all follow-up periods (0–7 days: HR 1.29, 95% CI 1.14–1.46; >365 days: HR 1.27, 95% CI 1.15–1.41). Elevated cardiovascular risk (QRISK2 ≥10) was associated with increased stroke risk in the early post-TIA period (HR 2.20, 95% CI 1.30–3.72), while unavailable QRISK2 scores were associated with higher risk, beyond one year (HR 4.04, 95% CI 2.42–6.74). Socioeconomic deprivation was associated with gradient increase in longer-term stroke risk especially among the most deprived. Standard coagulation parameters were recorded in only 16.2% of patients. In sensitivity analyses, individuals without any recorded coagulation-related testing had higher odds of subsequent stroke (aOR 1.48, 95% CI 1.38–1.59).

Interpretation: Stroke risk following TIA is dynamic, with key predictors showing important time-varying associations. These findings support time-aware risk stratification, enhanced post-TIA monitoring, and the need for and sustained post-TIA care in longer periods.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于威尔士全国人群队列（40,957名TIA患者），发现TIA后卒中风险随时间动态变化：年龄、糖尿病、心血管风险、社会经济剥夺等因素与卒中风险存在时变关联，提示需采用时间感知的风险分层和长期监测。
AI.research_question: TIA后卒中风险如何随时间演变？不同风险因素在TIA后不同时间窗（0-7天、8-30天、31-365天、>365天）对卒中风险的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: TIA后卒中风险高，但现有证据缺乏人群层面的时间动态描述，难以指导精准的二级预防策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间动态风险模型：将TIA后卒中风险按时间区间分层，识别风险因素的时变效应。
AI.method: 全国人群回顾性队列研究，采用多变量Cox比例风险回归（分时间区间建模），辅以广义线性混合效应模型（GLMER）进行敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 25.8%的TIA患者发生后续卒中；年龄增长在>1年后风险更高（HR 2.25）；糖尿病风险持续升高；高心血管风险（QRISK2≥10）在早期风险升高；社会经济剥夺与长期风险梯度相关；仅16.2%患者有凝血检测记录，无检测者卒中风险更高（aOR 1.48）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在全国人群层面系统揭示TIA后卒中风险因素的时变特征，为构建时间感知的风险分层模型提供实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持临床采用分时间窗的风险评估与监测策略，强调TIA后需加强长期（>1年）管理，并关注凝血检测缺失人群的风险。

title: The Biology of Global Amends: A Restorative Justice Framework for Protecting Women's TK in International IP

detail.title: The Biology of Global Amends: A Restorative Justice Framework for Protecting Women's TK in International IP

keywords: International Intellectual Property; Traditional Knowledge; 2024 GRATK Treaty; Restorative Justice Framework; Indigenous Female Innovation; Access and Benefit-Sharing (ABS); Nagoya Protocol; Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR); New York Convention; Uncompensated Utilization of TK.

detail.abstract:
For generations, the curation, testing, and transmission of global botanical medicine have been driven by highly structured, outcome-oriented systems developed and sustained by indigenous women. These women are high-achieving intergenerational scientists whose sustained intellectual and physical labor has produced measurable contributions to human health, ecological stewardship, and community survival across generations.

When this intergenerational research intersects with the international intellectual property (IP) regime, Traditional Knowledge (TK) is primarily addressed through mechanisms of disclosure and resource attribution. While administratively necessary, existing frameworks may recognize TK as a protectable resource, yet they insufficiently acknowledge the high-achieving intergenerational researchers whose labor, experimentation, stewardship, and scientific innovation produced and sustained these knowledge systems. This contributes to the ongoing structural exclusion of the indigenous women and communities underlying these biological resources, while leaving them without meaningful recourse in costly litigation environments.

To address this structural gap, this paper proposes a Restorative Justice (RJ)-based framework for international IP dispute resolution. Unlike existing TK regimes that primarily recognize knowledge as a resource, the proposed model restores recognition, participation, and accountability to the high-achieving intergenerational researchers and relational systems that generate and sustain these knowledge systems, consistent with RJ principles of inclusion, accountability, participation, and repair. Drawing on cellular repair and biological homeostasis as heuristics, it reframes dispute resolution as regenerative rather than adversarial, advancing a four-stage sequence—Inclusion, Encounter, Regulation, and Reintegration—supported by an Indigenous TK Early-Warning Registry and upfront Biomaterial Access Fees to reduce downstream economic risk.

The framework is operationalized through existing World Intellectual Property Organization alternative dispute resolution mechanisms, with enforceability grounded in the Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards. Ultimately, it argues that restoring attribution, economic participation, and procedural inclusion for indigenous women is essential to the legitimacy and sustainability of the global innovation system.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了现有国际知识产权制度对原住民女性科学家及其代际知识贡献的结构性忽视，并提出了一个基于恢复性正义（RJ）的知识产权争端解决框架，通过引入原住民传统知识预警登记册和前置生物材料准入费，将争端解决从对抗性转向再生性，以恢复这些高成就代际研究者的认可、参与和问责。
AI.research_question: 如何通过恢复性正义框架，解决国际知识产权争端解决中原住民女性代际研究者的结构性排斥问题，恢复她们在知识生产与创新体系中的认可、参与和问责？
AI.motivation: 现有国际知识产权制度将原住民传统知识仅视为可保护的资源，却忽视了背后进行代际实验、管理与创新的原住民女性科学家，导致她们在诉讼环境中缺乏实质性的法律救济与结构性包容。
AI.theoretical_framework: 恢复性正义（Restorative Justice）；以细胞修复和生物稳态作为比喻性启发（heuristics），将争端解决从对抗性转向再生性（regenerative）。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，提出四阶段序列模型（包容、接触、调节、重新融入），并结合现有法律机制（WIPO替代性争端解决、纽约公约）进行操作化设计。
AI.findings: 提出了一个包含原住民传统知识早期预警登记册和前置生物材料准入费的四阶段恢复性正义争端解决框架，可通过WIPO现有ADR机制和纽约公约执行。
AI.theory_contributions: 将恢复性正义理论引入国际知识产权争端解决领域，并以生物学修复过程为喻，提出"再生性"而非"对抗性"的争端解决范式转换。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际知识产权机构提供了可操作的具体机制（早期预警登记册、前置准入费、四阶段流程），旨在降低原住民社区的经济风险并增强其程序包容性。

title: The Dynamics of Income Distributions: Redistribution and Consolidation in Evolving Systems
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: The Dynamics of Income Distributions: Redistribution and Consolidation in Evolving Systems
detail.abstract: Income inequality is typically assessed using scalar indicators such as the Gini coefficient and top income shares. Although these measures quantify the degree of concentration at a given point in time, they provide limited information about how the structure of the income distribution changes over time. We develop an information theoretic framework that treats income shares as evolving probability distributions and distinguish between two dimensions of inequality: distributional concentration, measured by Shannon entropy, and distributional restructuring, measured by the Jensen-Shannon divergence between successive distributions. Applying this framework to data for the United States, India, China, and Iceland, reveals alternating phases of relative persistence and periods of elevated restructuring. The timing, duration, and intensity of these phases vary across countries, indicating that similar levels of inequality can conceal markedly different underlying dynamics. To interpret these findings, we develop a minimal evolutionary model based on the Tangled Nature framework. The model demonstrates that interacting systems undergoing endogenous variation and selection naturally generate punctuated dynamics characterized by alternating restructuring and consolidation. Together, the results suggest that inequality is defined not only by its level, but also by the temporal organization of distributional change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个信息论框架，将收入份额视为演化的概率分布，区分了收入不平等中的"分布集中度"（香农熵）和"分布重构度"（Jensen-Shannon散度）两个维度，并通过对美国、印度、中国和冰岛的数据分析，发现相似的不平等水平可能掩盖截然不同的动态变化过程。
AI.research_question: 收入分配结构如何随时间演化？传统标量指标（如基尼系数）所衡量的不平等水平背后，是否隐藏着不同的动态变化模式？
AI.motivation: 传统不平等指标（如基尼系数、顶部收入份额）仅能衡量某一时点的集中程度，无法捕捉收入分布结构随时间的变化动态。作者希望通过信息论框架揭示不平等水平之外的"时间维度"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论框架（香农熵衡量分布集中度，Jensen-Shannon散度衡量分布重构度）；Tangled Nature演化模型（内生变异与选择驱动的交互系统）。
AI.method: 提出基于信息论的二维不平等测量框架，应用于美国、印度、中国、冰岛四国的收入数据；并构建基于Tangled Nature框架的最小演化模型进行理论解释。
AI.findings: （1）各国收入分配呈现交替的相对稳定期与重构期；（2）重构期的时机、持续时间和强度因国而异；（3）相似的不平等水平可能对应截然不同的底层动态；（4）演化模型表明，交互系统在内生变异与选择下自然产生间断均衡式的重构与巩固交替。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不平等研究从静态的"水平"维度拓展到动态的"时间组织"维度；提出"分布重构度"作为不平等研究的新概念；通过演化模型为不平等动态提供微观理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更丰富的不平等监测工具：不仅关注不平等水平，还应关注分配结构的变化动态；有助于识别不平等"表面稳定但内部重构"的隐蔽时期。

title: Wash Trading in Polymarket V1 NegRisk, January-December 2024: SMKS Methodology Extension, Magnitude Divergence, and an Election-Cycle Hypothesis

detail.title: Wash Trading in Polymarket V1 NegRisk, January-December 2024: SMKS Methodology Extension, Magnitude Divergence, and an Election-Cycle Hypothesis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no financial relationships with Polymarket Inc., its parent company, or any prediction-market venue discussed in this paper. The author has no compensated relationships with Sirolly, Ma, Kanoria, or Sethi (authors of SMKS 2025), and the work is conducted independently of any affiliation with Columbia GSB or Barnard College. The author maintains a public Hugging Face dataset (alphalab-research/polymarket-2024) and a public GitHub repository (alphalab-research/wash-replication-2026) associated with this work, both released under CC-BY-NC-4.0.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzes anonymized public on-chain blockchain trade data (Polymarket V1 NegRisk contracts on Polygon) and does not involve human subjects, identifiable individuals, or proprietary or private data. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research is self-funded. No external funding, grants, fellowships, or sponsored research arrangements supported this work.

detail.abstract:
We extend the network-based wash-trading detection methodology of Sirolly et al. (SMKS, 2025) to a new sample: 16.96M Polymarket V1 NegRisk trades across 199 markets covering 2024-01-05 to 2024-12-07 (the eleven-month pre-election and immediate post-election window, $3.5B notional). The methodological contribution is fourfold: (1) closed-form per-market θ tuning that compresses the threshold logarithmically with market scale and recovers pair-level signal on $100M+ markets where SMKS's flat 0.70 cutoff under-flags (the volume-share feature collapses to ≈ 10^-6 at scale, pushing the maximum achievable pair score below the cutoff); (2) the wrapped-collateral discovery, identifying the Polymarket Wrapped Collateral wrapper at 0x3A3B...02E2 (not USDC.e) as the correct collateral input to the CTHelpers getPositionId chain — 38/38 markets resolve with the wrapper, 0/38 with USDC.e; (3) NegRiskIdLib byte-zeroing family-ID inference, recovering parent-event identifiers for every NegRisk market without a Gamma API round-trip; (4) a public, license-clean reproducibility release under CC-BY-NC-4.0. 

The empirical headline is magnitude divergence, not replication. On our 11-month sample the overall wash rate is 0.22% (37,786 flagged trades over 16.96M), peaking at 0.96% in July 2024 and 0.40% in the first week of December 2024. These figures are 50–150× below SMKS's reported magnitudes (their reported December 2024 peak: ≈ 60%; their reported October 2025 peak: ≈ 20%). Our window closes 2024-12-07, just 32 days after the 5 November 2024 U.S. general election and likely before the bulk of SMKS's December focal weeks; we do not measure their headline peak. We offer an election-cycle hypothesis: wash activity intensifies in the position-settlement and PnL-reconciliation weeks following major attention events. Our July 2024 sub-peak coincides with two contemporaneous attention shocks (Trump assassination attempt, 13 July; Biden withdrawal, 21 July) consistent with the same mechanism on a smaller scale. The full SMKS magnitude-overlap question is queued for a planned v0.2 release covering the V1 endgame (Dec 2024 onward) and the V2 era (28 April 2026 onward), feeding off the Alpha Lab extended NegRisk monitor that has been live since May 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文在 Polymarket 上扩展了 SMKS (2025) 的刷量交易检测方法，发现了数量级差异（0.22% vs 20–60%），而非复制其结果，并提出了四项方法改进和选举周期假说。
AI.research_question: 在 Polymarket V1 NegRisk 市场中，SMKS 的刷量交易检测方法能否复制？刷量规模与之前报告有多大差距？
AI.motivation: SMKS (2025) 报告了极高的刷量比例（20–60%），但该方法在大规模市场中存在阈值失效问题；本文旨在扩展方法并检验结果的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网络的刷量交易检测方法；对数压缩阈值调优；选举周期假说（注意力事件后结算与盈亏对账期刷量加剧）。
AI.method: 四项方法论贡献：(1) 闭式每市场 θ 调优；(2) Wrapped Collateral 发现；(3) NegRiskIdLib 字节归零的系列 ID 推断；(4) 公开可复现的数据发布。样本：16.96M 笔交易，199 个市场，2024-01-05 至 2024-12-07。
AI.findings: 整体刷量率 0.22%（37,786 笔/16.96M），远低于 SMKS 报告的 20–60%；2024 年 7 月峰值 0.96%，12 月第一周 0.40%。提出选举周期假说解释差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了刷量检测方法对阈值设定的敏感性，提出了注意力事件-结算周期的刷量动态理论假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复现的刷量检测代码与数据集（CC-BY-NC-4.0）；纠正了 Polymarket 的抵押品地址识别；建立了持续监测平台。

title: Can Digital Technologies Substitute for Institutional Protection? Evidence From Women's Mobility
affiliations: American University,  and University of Bath
